### [112] [Ask a Language Model for Lottery Numbers: Concentration in Repeated Six-of-49 Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00052)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文评估六种语言模型配置生成六个1-49随机整数的能力，发现模型输出呈现显著集中模式，有效多样性远低于理论均匀分布基准，模态彩票占比高达22.5%-68.0%，但未揭示机制或泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究语言模型在生成伪随机数（如彩票号码）时的统计特性，量化其输出偏离独立均匀分布的程度，填补LLM随机性评估的空白。

Method: 对六种LLM配置使用四种英文提示变体，共1200次调用请求生成6个1-49不重复整数；以有效多样性指标衡量号码频率分布均匀度，对比蒙特卡洛模拟的第五百分位阈值；统计唯一无序彩票数量及模态彩票占比；引入两组波兰乐透实物开奖数据作为物理随机基准。

Result: 1184次有效响应中，有效多样性仅9.9-18.0，远低于模拟阈值46.6-46.7；各系统仅产生8-93种不同无序彩票，模态彩票占比22.5%-68.0%；波兰乐透样本有效多样性为41.1和41.4，接近理论值。

Conclusion: 在测试部署设置下，LLM生成的伪随机数表现出显著的分布集中与模式崩塌，远偏离均匀分布；但未识别具体成因，亦未验证其他提示、温度或工具配置下的表现。

Abstract: We evaluate six language-model configurations on requests for six distinct random integers from 1-49. Across 1,200 attempted calls using four English prompt variants, 1,184 responses yielded valid tickets. Effective diversity of number frequencies ranged from 9.9 to 18.0, compared with simulated fifth-percentile thresholds of 46.6-46.7 under independent uniform six-of-49 sampling at the corresponding sample sizes. Systems produced 8-93 distinct unordered tickets, and their modal tickets accounted for 22.5-68.0% of valid responses. Two archived Polish Lotto samples provided a physical-lottery comparison, with effective diversities of 41.1 and 41.4 at smaller sample sizes. These results demonstrate substantial concentration under the tested deployment settings. They do not identify its mechanism or establish performance under other prompts, temperatures, or tool configurations.

</details>


### [113] [On-Device Commercial Intent Retrieval Under Size, Latency, and Privacy Constraints: A 3 MiB Retrieval System with Typed Egress Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00170)
*Hyojung Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究在严格设备端约束下（载荷<3MiB、Tier-0推理<20ms p95、无原始数据出设备）的商业意图推理。通过量化蒸馏的韩语句子变换器嵌入表，在6,020叶分类树上实现检索。实验显示：锚点子串存在时Top-5准确率83.5%，无锚点仅45.2%；大模型教师微调后在有锚点+10.6pp、无锚点+20.9pp超越学生模型；设备端可通过置信度边际拒绝低置信样本提升至82.96%。载荷2.94MB，iPhone A14/A16及骁龙695平台均满足延迟要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决商业意图推理在严格隐私与资源约束下的设备端部署问题：需同时满足模型体积<3MiB、推理延迟p95<20ms、零原始数据出设备三大硬性约束，且针对韩语电商场景的6,020类细粒度分类任务。

Method: 采用知识蒸馏与量化压缩：从韩语句子变换器蒸馏静态嵌入表，量化至4位，构建无运行时推理的检索路径；监督信号主要来自合成韩语语料；在设备端通过嵌入表查找与相似度计算完成6,020叶节点检索。

Result: 1) 真实韩语电商文本(22,900条)上中类Top-5准确率75.0%（基线18.4%）；2) 存在叶节点子串锚点时83.5%，无锚点仅45.2%；3) 196.6倍大教师模型微调后达0.8586，有锚点+10.6pp、无锚点+20.9pp超越学生；4) 无锚点时任务适应对教师无增益，揭示学生模型容量不足；5) 设备端可通过置信度边际拒绝最低置信样本将其余提升至82.96%；6) 厂商型号码特征经固定效应控制后不显著(-4.0pp, p=0.51)，锚点显著(+13.0pp)；7) 载荷2,942,652字节，Tier-0 p95延迟:iPhone A14 4.431ms、A16 3.670ms、骁龙695 5.080ms，均慢于服务端CPU。

Conclusion: 在极端设备端约束下，锚点子串的有无是决定性分界线：有锚点时蒸馏量化模型已近饱和，无锚点时模型容量成为瓶颈且教师模型任务适应无效。可通过设备端置信度边际动态拒绝低置信预测以权衡覆盖率与准确率。合成监督数据在受限分类树上表现可行。

Abstract: We study commercial intent inference that runs entirely on the user's device, under three constraints frozen before the work began: the downloaded payload under 3 MiB, Tier-0 inference under 20 ms at p95, and no raw text, content embedding, or stable identifier leaving the device. Under them we build a retrieval path over a 6,020-leaf commercial taxonomy: a static embedding table distilled from a Korean sentence transformer, quantized to 4 bits, no inference runtime.
  Our main result is where that constraint costs accuracy. On real Korean commerce text labelled by others (22,900 AI-Hub shopping reviews), mid-category top-5 on real product names is 75.0% against an 18.4% permutation baseline, but splits on one observable: a query containing some leaf name as a substring scores 83.5%, one containing none 45.2%. A generic 196.6x larger teacher seemed to localize the gap (+20.1 pp without an anchor, +0.1 with). That null was two effects cancelling: the same teacher fine-tuned on the student's own contrastive pairs reaches 0.8586 and beats the pure-encoder student by +10.6 pp with an anchor and +20.9 pp without. The cost is not uniform, but it is not free anywhere; where the anchor is absent, task adaptation buys the teacher nothing, so what the constrained encoder lacks there is capacity. The expensive regime is detectable on-device from the ranker's own score margin: declining the least confident fifth lifts the rest to 0.8296.
  A second axis we first reported, a manufacturer model code, does not survive source-category fixed effects (-4.0 pp, p=0.51); the anchor does (+13.0 pp).
  Payload is 2,942,652 bytes, all three library links measured. Tier-0 p95 is 4.431 and 3.670 ms on two iPhones (A14, A16) and 5.080 ms on a budget Android tablet (Snapdragon 695), all slower than three server CPUs on the same code. Taxonomy supervision is mostly synthetic Korean utterances.

</details>


### [114] [System Attribution in LLM Brand Recommendations: Single Responses Identify the System, Aggregated Brand Profiles Do Not Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00253)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文研究AI可见性审计，通过分析部署语言模型的品牌推荐构建系统画像。实验表明，单个回答的表层形式（字符n-gram）能以97.84%准确率识别模型，但聚合后的品牌行为画像无法跨领域泛化（礼品推荐与品类所有权领域品牌量反转导致全错），且未交叉设计无法将系统效应与领域/采集工具效应分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI可见性审计将部署语言模型的品牌推荐汇总为系统级画像，但尚不清楚这种画像是否真实描述了系统本身，还是混淆了查询领域、采集工具等混杂因素。本文旨在验证系统画像的有效性及其跨领域泛化能力。

Method: 收集2025年12月至2026年2月五个部署端点（GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Flash、Gemini 3 Flash with search、Grok、Perplexity sonar-pro）在礼品推荐、企业声誉、品类所有权三类查询下的6,475个回答（6,324可分析）。使用字符n-gram分类器进行交叉验证归因；截断至前800字符；消融实验测试长度、格式统计、品牌名/大写掩码等特征；聚合为50个模型×领域×条件单元，用12个行为特征在分组交叉验证下区分四系统；跨领域迁移测试用随机森林。

Result: 单回答归因准确率97.84%（多数类31.5%）；长度特征退化至多数类率；24个格式统计达95.79%；掩码品牌名/大写仍保97.72%。留出查询条件加权97.43%、不加权88.0%；检索增强臂下Grok归因率0/120。聚合单元下12特征分组交叉验证66.53%（置换零分布均值33.71%、95分位46.0%）。跨领域迁移失效：品类所有权训练的森林将全部22个礼品单元误分类（品牌量反转：礼品8.41 vs 0.94，品类所有权3.01 vs 3.91）；单回答跨领域平衡准确率89.92%。

Conclusion: 回答的表层形式携带跨查询领域的系统特征；聚合品牌行为不具备跨领域稳定性；由于采集工具与领域未交叉设计，无法将系统效应与领域效应或工具效应分离。

Abstract: Audits of AI visibility summarise the brand recommendations of deployed language models into per-system profiles. We test whether such a profile describes the system on one corpus of 6,475 stored responses (6,324 analysable) collected between December 2025 and February 2026 from five deployed endpoints across gift-recommendation, corporate-reputation and category-ownership queries. The collection harness cut many answers short: 83.1% of Gemini 3 Flash answers in category ownership end mid-sentence under a 1,024-token output cap. With every answer cut to its first 800 characters, a character n-gram classifier cross-validated by prompt attributes one response to GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash with search, Grok or Perplexity sonar-pro with 97.84% accuracy (5,028 responses, 383 prompts, majority class 31.5%, 30 split seeds). Length alone falls to the majority rate, 24 formatting statistics reach 95.79%, and masking brand names and capitalised tokens leaves 97.72%. Held-out query conditions keep 97.43% weighted by size and 88.0% unweighted; in a retrieval-grounded arm that changes the harness, no Grok answer is attributed to Grok (0/120). Aggregated into 50 model-by-domain-by-condition units, twelve behavioural features separate four systems at 66.53% under grouped cross-validation, against a label-permutation null with mean 33.71% and 95th percentile 46.0%. Across domains the aggregate profile fails: a forest trained on category-ownership units assigns all 22 gift units to the wrong system, consistent with a reversal in brand volume (8.41 against 0.94 brands per response in gifts, 3.01 against 3.91 in category ownership), while single responses transfer at 89.92% balanced accuracy. The surface form of an answer carries the system across the query domains tested; aggregated brand behaviour does not, and the uncrossed design cannot separate the system from the domain or the harness.

</details>


### [115] [A Shared Taste for Model-Written Text: The Generator-by-Selector Matrices of "AI-AI Bias" Show No Detectable Own-Model Premium](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00369)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文重新分析了 Laurito 等人 (PNAS 2025) 的数据，探究大语言模型在选择时是否偏好自家生成的文本。通过在 5×5 生成器-选择器矩阵上拟合双向固定效应模型并引入自模型项 γ，利用精确排列检验发现：在产品、论文摘要、电影三个领域及汇总数据中，自模型偏好均不显著（汇总 γ=+0.019, p=0.14）。功效分析表明设计可检测约 0.04 的效应量，低于此值则无结论。Tan 等人 (ACL 2024) 的 4×4 矩阵虽给出 γ=+0.148，但其排列检验分辨率有限。核心结论：模型间存在共享的对模型生成文本的偏好（GPT-4 文本在产品任务中被所有选择器以 77%-95% 的概率选中），但无证据表明模型能识别并偏爱自己的文风。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Laurito 等人 (PNAS 2025) 发现大语言模型普遍偏好模型生成的文本而非人类撰写的文本，但其实验设计（5 个生成器 × 5 个选择器）尚未回答一个次要问题：选择器是否在主效应之上额外偏好自家模型生成的文本（即“自模型溢价”）。本文旨在利用公开数据重建矩阵，严格检验这一自模型偏好是否存在。

Method: 从作者公开仓库的逐项计数重建三个 5×5 矩阵（共 21,828 次有效试验，每个单元格与发表值完全匹配）。拟合双向固定效应模型，包含生成器主效应、选择器主效应及自模型交互项 γ。采用精确排列检验，对选择器标签进行 120 种全排列以获得 p 值。同时分析位置偏差影响、进行功效分析，并对比 Tan 等人 (ACL 2024) 的 4×4 矩阵结果。

Result: 自模型溢价 γ 在产品 (+0.013, p=0.24)、论文摘要 (-0.010, p=0.74)、电影 (+0.054, p=0.07) 及汇总数据 (+0.019, p=0.14; 95% CI -0.008 到 0.046) 中均不显著。GPT-3.5 与 GPT-4 同厂商项在三个数据集中均为负值。位置偏差可使单个单元格偏移达 0.42 份额点，但剔除顺序驱动项后自模型对比不变。功效分析显示：汇总数据在 80% 功效下最小可检测效应为 0.034，缺乏显著性可排除约 0.04 以上的溢价。Tan 等人 (2024) 的 4×4 矩阵给出 γ=+0.148，但仅有 24 种排列，检验分辨率极低。

Conclusion: 数据确认了 Laurito 等人的主结论：不同模型共享对模型生成文本的偏好（GPT-4 文本在产品任务中被所有选择器以 77%-95% 概率选中）。然而，现有证据不支持模型能识别并特别偏爱自己生成的文本这一假设。自模型偏好若存在，其效应量小于约 0.04 份额点，低于当前实验设计的检测阈值。

Abstract: Laurito et al. (PNAS 2025) showed that large language models choosing between two descriptions of the same product, paper or film prefer the description written by a language model over the one written by a person, by a wide margin over what human judges do. Their design crosses five generators with the same five models as selectors, which permits a second question the paper does not headline: does a selector prefer text from its own model beyond what the generator and selector main effects predict? We rebuild the three 5x5 matrices from the per-item counts in the authors' public repository (21,828 valid trials; every cell matches the published value) and fit a two-way fixed-effects model with an own-model term gamma, tested by the exact permutation test over the 120 relabellings of the selectors. The premium is +0.013 on products (exact one-sided p = 0.24), -0.010 on paper abstracts (p = 0.74), +0.054 on films (p = 0.07) and +0.019 pooled (p = 0.14; 95% interval -0.008 to 0.046). The same-vendor term for the GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 pair is negative in all three datasets. Position bias moves single cells by up to 0.42 share points in either direction, and the own-model contrast is unchanged once order-driven items are removed. The design would have detected a premium of 0.05 with 82% (products), 88% (papers), 42% (films) and 97% (pooled) power; the minimum detectable effect at 80% power is 0.034 pooled. The absence is informative down to about 0.04 share points and silent below that. The 4x4 matrix of Tan et al. (ACL 2024) gives gamma = +0.148 at the smallest p its 24 relabellings allow, with a same-family term of the same size. The main result of Laurito et al. stands: models share a taste for model-written text, with GPT-4's descriptions chosen 77% to 95% of the time by every selector on products. What these data do not show is a model recognising and favouring its own prose.

</details>


### [116] [Comparison of Common Crawl News & GDELT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00587)
*Ameir El Ouadi,David Beskow*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对比了两大全球新闻数据集GDELT和Common Crawl News，分析其内容覆盖差异，揭示两者新闻来源获取方式存在显著不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球新闻语料对自然语言处理、知识图谱、大语言模型等技术至关重要，也对理解实时交互的人、地、组织、事件不可或缺，因此需要评估现有主流新闻数据集的优劣与覆盖差异。

Method: 通过对比分析GDELT（依赖广播、印刷及网络新闻）与Common Crawl News（通过网络爬虫聚焦全球新闻站点）的内容来源、覆盖范围及采集策略，评估两数据集的优势与局限。

Result: 研究发现两数据集在新闻来源采集地点上存在显著差异：GDELT涵盖广播、印刷及网络新闻，而Common Crawl News专注于通过网络爬虫获取的新闻站点内容。

Conclusion: 两大数据集各有优劣，选择时需根据具体任务需求考虑来源多样性与采集方式的差异，未来研究可进一步探索两者互补融合的可能性。

Abstract: The corpus of worldwide news is important for natural language processing, knowledge graphs, large language models, and other technical efforts. Additionally, this corpus is important for understanding the people, places, organizations, and events that interact in real-time every day. This paper compares two news datasets used for these tasks today, namely the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) and Common Crawl News. Our research highlights the strengths and limitations of each dataset, analyzing their content and coverage. Notably, while GDELT relies on broadcasts, prints, and web news from across the globe, Common Crawl focuses on news sites from around the world gathered through web crawling. Our analysis revealed considerable differences in where the two datasets gather their news sources.

</details>


### [117] [CANOPY: Adaptive-Granularity Evidence Compression for Multimodal RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00923)
*Hyojeong Yun,Jueun Kim,Wook-Shin Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 CANOPY (Canonical Projection over Hierarchy)，一种用于多模态 RAG 的自适应粒度检索后证据压缩框架。CANOPY 将检索项表示为层级结构，利用在金标准证据上微调的节点编码器对区域进行查询相关性打分，通过父节点相对细化在不调用 LLM 的情况下选择多粒度区域；同时引入评论机制，在积累证据不足时请求针对性追加检索。在 3300 万项异构语料库上的五个 QA 基准测试中，CANOPY 实现了更高的平均回答准确率，且在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 设置下将读取器输入 token 减少 14.2%-27.7%，准确率相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态 RAG 检索文本、表格、图像、视频等异构模态，但检索粒度选择无法决定每个项内保留多少上下文。粗粒度单元包含无关内容，统一细粒度选择又可能移除解读证据所需的上下文。现有压缩器依赖模态特定机制，缺乏跨异构项按区域自适应调整保留范围的通用流程。

Method: CANOPY 将检索项构建为层级树，使用在金标准证据上微调的节点编码器为每个节点计算与查询的相关性分数；采用父节点相对细化策略，对比父子节点分数以在多粒度层面选取证据区域，无需 LLM 逐节点剪枝。引入评论模块判断累积证据是否充分，不足时发起针对性追加检索，新检索项经压缩后合并。整个流程为迭代式检索-压缩循环。

Result: 在包含 3300 万项的异构语料库上跨五个 QA 基准评测，CANOPY 平均回答准确率超越所有对比检索基线。消融实验显示，追加检索机制是多跳 QA 准确率提升的主要驱动因素。在无路由的 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 读取器设置下，压缩使读取器输入 evidence token 减少 14.2%-27.7%，同时保持相当的回答准确率。

Conclusion: CANOPY 提供了一种统一的、模态无关的自适应粒度证据压缩框架，通过层级表示与父节点相对细化实现高效多粒度证据选择，配合评论驱动的迭代追加检索，显著提升多跳 QA 性能并大幅降低下游读取器的 token 开销，为大规模异构语料库上的多模态 RAG 提供了实用的检索后处理方案。

Abstract: Multimodal RAG retrieves text, tables, images, and videos, but choosing a retrieval granularity does not determine how much context to retain within each item. Coarse units include irrelevant content, while uniformly fine selection can remove context needed to interpret the evidence. Existing compressors address this trade-off with modality-specific mechanisms, leaving open a shared procedure for adapting the retained extent region by region across heterogeneous items. We introduce CANOPY (Canonical Projection over Hierarchy), a framework for adaptive-granularity post-retrieval evidence compression. CANOPY represents retrieved items as hierarchies and uses a node encoder fine-tuned on gold evidence to score regions against the query. Parent-relative refinement compares these scores to select multiple regions at different granularities without LLM calls for node-level pruning. Because compression cannot recover evidence that was never retrieved, a critic requests targeted follow-up retrieval when it judges the accumulated evidence insufficient; newly retrieved items are compressed before being added. Across five QA benchmarks over a 33M-item heterogeneous corpus, CANOPY achieves higher average answer accuracy than the evaluated retrieval baselines. Ablations indicate that additional retrieval drives the main accuracy gains on multi-hop QA. In the unrouted Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct setting, compression reduces reader-input evidence tokens by 14.2-27.7% relative to the same iterative pipeline without compression, with comparable answer accuracy.

</details>


### [118] [RPTune: Learned Context Curation for LLM Catalog Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00964)
*Chuxuan Hu,Hejie Cui,Norman Huang,Shubham Kumar Bharti,Wang-Chiew Tan,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 针对小型商家全目录搜索中LLM长上下文利用不均的问题，提出RPTune框架：通过编码器-重组器策展人结合LLM反馈进行目录裁剪排序，再利用策展后的目录进行基于上下文相对奖励的LLM后训练，在7个真实商家上实现搜索准确率显著提升（策展增益达31.4pp，后训练再增10.3pp）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型商家（SMBs）产品目录规模可放入长上下文LLM，全目录提示可替代多阶段检索；但LLM无法均匀利用长上下文，导致全目录塞入窗口仍无法有效使用，需解决目录如何策展呈现及LLM如何适配策展上下文两大问题。

Method: 提出端到端RPTune框架：1) 编码器-重组器策展人根据下游LLM反馈对产品进行排序裁剪，生成策展目录；2) 基于策展目录自动生成目录地面真值监督，采用上下文相对奖励进行LLM后训练；两者协同优化，形成闭环。

Result: 在7个跨垂直领域真实商家、每商家100条复杂对话查询上评估：RPTune在专有和开源LLM上均稳定提升搜索准确率，目录策展带来最高31.4个百分点增益，后训练平均再增10.3个百分点。

Conclusion: RPTune通过学习式目录策展与LLM后训练的耦合，有效解决了长上下文利用不均问题，为中小商家提供了低成本、高精度的全目录搜索方案，验证了策展与适配协同的必要性与有效性。

Abstract: For small merchant businesses (SMBs) whose catalogs fit within a long-context LLM, full-catalog prompting offers a compelling alternative to multi-stage retrieval designed primarily for large marketplaces with millions of items. However, fitting the full catalog into the context window does not ensure that the model can use it effectively, since LLMs do not exploit long contexts uniformly. We therefore study in-context catalog search through two complementary questions: (1) how to curate and present catalogs to the LLM, and (2) how to adapt the LLM for product selection on curated contexts.
  We propose RPTune, an end-to-end framework that couples learned catalog curation with LLM post-training using automatically generated, catalog-grounded supervision. An encoder-reorganizer curator orders and prunes products guided by downstream LLM feedback, while the resulting curated catalogs in turn improve the effectiveness of LLM post-training with a context-relative reward. We evaluate RPTune on 7 real merchants spanning distinct retail verticals, using 100 complex conversational queries per merchant. RPTune consistently improves search accuracy across both proprietary and open-weight LLMs, with context curation yielding gains of up to 31.4 percentage points and post-training adding a further 10.3 points on average.

</details>


### [119] [Do Multilingual Encoders Produce Language-Consistent Semantic IDs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01139)
*Abhinav Bohra,Anuj Bohra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文研究多语言语义ID(SID)在跨语言商品检索中的一致性，发现多语言编码器和均衡码本使用不能保证跨语言SID一致，英语主导拟合下日语翻译仅7.7%保留首码，均衡拟合反而降低一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究多语言编码器是否足以使同一商品的不同语言渲染获得语言一致的语义ID(SID)，以及残差量化是否对翻译引起的嵌入位移敏感，均衡量化器拟合是否能改善跨语言SID一致性。

Method: 使用Amazon ESCI数据集的英语、西班牙语、日语渲染，采用多语言E5编码器，对比英语主导拟合与均衡拟合下的SID一致性，引入距离匹配的商品导向对照组以测试量化器是否放大语言方向。

Result: 多语言E5将翻译嵌入显著分离：英语主导拟合下日语翻译仅7.7%保留首码(英语重述为89.0%)；距离匹配对照组产生相似的全SID不匹配，无证据表明量化器选择性放大语言方向；均衡拟合使码本使用更均匀但进一步降低跨语言前缀一致性(西班牙语首码一致性从28.3%降至6.6%，英语单一拟合为67.6%)。

Conclusion: 多语言暴露和均衡码本使用本身不足以保证语言一致的SID，英语主导拟合反而能更好地保持跨语言SID前缀一致性，揭示了生成式检索中跨语言语义ID对齐的挑战。

Abstract: Semantic IDs (SIDs) compress item embeddings into discrete code sequences used in generative retrieval. We ask whether a multilingual encoder is sufficient for different-language renderings of the same product to receive language-consistent SIDs. Using Amazon ESCI listings rendered in English, Spanish, and Japanese, we test whether translations remain close to their English source, whether residual quantization is unusually sensitive to translation-induced movement, and whether multilingual or language-balanced quantizer fitting improves SID agreement. Multilingual E5 places translations measurably apart: under an English-heavy fit, a Japanese translation preserves the first SID code of its English counterpart in only 7.7% of cases, compared with 89.0% for an English rewording. Distance-matched product-directed controls produce nearly the same full-SID mismatch as translation, providing no evidence that the quantizer selectively amplifies language directions. Balancing the fitting mixture makes codebook use more uniform but further reduces cross-lingual prefix agreement: Spanish first-code consistency falls from 28.3% to 6.6%, while an English-only fit preserves it for 67.6% of Spanish translations. These results show that multilingual exposure and balanced codebook use alone do not guarantee language-consistent SIDs.

</details>


### [120] [Learning to structure data from user-generated thematic corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01463)
*Elishay Avram,Oren Glickman,Elad Yom-Tov*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种全自动迭代框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）从主题语料库（如社交媒体社区）中无需预定义本体即可发现并抽取领域特定属性模式，实现结构化数据集的低成本大规模构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主题语料库中包含大量非结构化文本描述的数据（如个人属性、行为、经历），但相关属性往往隐含、领域相关且事先未知，传统方法依赖预定义本体，难以适应新领域，亟需自动化、可扩展的模式发现方法。

Method: 框架分三阶段：1) 利用LLM从语料中诱导候选属性；2) 迭代合并语义重叠属性，并分配结构类型（如分类、数值、文本），形成本体；3) 用该本体指导数值抽取，并支持用较小LLM替代大模型进行抽取，且可估算精度损失。

Result: 在5个健康相关Reddit社区评估：发现属性与人工标注一致性61%（接近标注者间一致性62%）；多数情况<10轮收敛；结构类型分配准确率82%；数值抽取F1达0.8；四个LLM家族中，较小指令微调模型随规模增大性能显著提升，支持精度-成本权衡。

Conclusion: 研究证明可自动发现媲美人工的属性模式，消除预定义本体依赖，为主题语料库挖掘提供实用、可扩展的基础，实现高质量结构化数据集的经济大规模构建。

Abstract: Thematic corpora, such as social media communities, contain unstructured text describing data that could be made structured. These include, for example, personal attributes, behaviors, and experiences mentioned in social media data. Extracting structured data is challenging as relevant attributes are often implicit, domain-dependent, and unknown in advance. We propose a fully automated, iterative framework for discovering and extracting domain-specific attribute schemas without a predefined ontology. Using large language models (LLMs), the framework induces candidate attributes, sequentially consolidates semantically overlapping attributes, and assigns a structural type. These enable creating an ontology and populating it with values from the corpus. The framework also enables the use of smaller LLMs for value extraction with estimable accuracy loss compared to large LLMs. We evaluate the framework on 5 health-related Reddit communities. Discovered attributes achieved 61% agreement with human-identified attributes, close to the 62% agreement between independent annotators. In most cases, the algorithm converges to a stable attribute set in fewer than 10 iterations. Structural type assignment achieves 82% accuracy, and value extraction reaches an F1 score of 0.8 compared to human annotations. Across four LLM families, smaller instruction-tuned models show statistically significant improvements in extraction performance with model scale when evaluated against a high-capacity reference LLM, supporting informed accuracy-cost trade-offs. These results show that attributes comparable to those identified by humans can be discovered automatically, enabling the creation of high-quality structured datasets economically and at scale. By removing the need for predefined ontologies, iterative model-driven schema induction offers a practical and scalable foundation for mining thematic corpora.

</details>


### [121] [From Rules to Neural Graphs: Scalable Structured Prediction for Patent Prior Art Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01553)
*Nikolai Zenovkin,Sebastian Björkqvist*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于局部双仿射注意力的神经解析器，直接从专利文本预测发明图，支持超长文档处理并提升下游检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专利检索需处理数万词元的长文档，现有神经检索方法截断输入限制效果；基于图的检索虽用结构化发明图但依赖脆弱的规则解析器，亟需端到端的神经解析方案。

Method: 将依赖解析中的双仿射注意力改造为局部滑动窗口形式，将成对打分复杂度从 O(n²) 降至 O(n·w)；局部与全局打分共享权重，使模型可在短序列上训练、在超 40k 词元文档上部署且无需微调；从 100 万规则解析文档中蒸馏训练。

Result: 推理成本降至教师模型的 1/3，在下游 Graph Transformer 检索系统中，神经图使短查询的引文召回率提升 0.5%，全文档查询提升 1.1%。

Conclusion: 神经解析器成功替代了基于规则的解析器，实现了高效的长专利文档发明图构建，显著降低推理开销并提升检索召回率。

Abstract: Patent search requires processing documents routinely exceeding tens of thousands of tokens. Most neural retrieval approaches operate on truncated inputs, limiting their effectiveness. Graph-based retrieval addresses this by representing each patent as a structured invention graph, but constructing these graphs relies on brittle rule-based parsers. We present the neural parser, which adapts biaffine attention from dependency parsing to predict invention graphs directly from patent text. Our local biaffine attention restricts pairwise scoring to a sliding window, reducing complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n \cdot w)$. Since local and global scoring share the same weights, the model trains on short sequences and deploys on documents exceeding 40,000 tokens without retraining. Distilled from 1 million rule-parsed documents, it surpasses its teacher at 3$\times$ lower inference cost: neural graphs improve citation recall by 0.5% on short queries and 1.1% on full documents in a downstream Graph Transformer retrieval system.

</details>


### [122] [AgentWebRec: Compact Evidence Fusion over the Agent Web for Personalized Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01705)
*Haoran Qiang,Guannan Liu,Liang Zhang,Junjie Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出AgentWebRec框架，针对基于LLM的个人代理网络中的推荐问题，将推荐重构为任务时的证据获取与融合，在有限预算下决定查询什么和保留什么，利用平台提供的物品语义、目标用户代理的私有记忆，并在本地证据不足时有条件查询邻居代理，实验证明优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推荐面临用户-平台直接交互，但随着LLM个人代理出现，形成用户-代理网络-平台路径。代理间证据分散、不透明、查询受限、语义异构，且仅小部分相关，传统聚合数据学习失效，需在任务时动态获取融合证据。

Method: AgentWebRec框架：逐步获取融合分布式证据，保持代理记忆本地化。每个决策基于平台提供的物品语义和目标用户代理私有记忆中的任务相关证据；当本地证据不足时，有条件查询邻居用户代理获取互补偏好模式。在有限证据预算下决定查询什么和保留什么。

Result: 在四个InstructRec数据集上实验，AgentWebRec持续优于基线推荐器；消融实验验证证据层贡献互补增益。

Conclusion: 将推荐重构为代理网络上的任务时证据获取融合问题，提出AgentWebRec框架有效解决分布式、异构、预算受限的证据利用挑战，实验验证其优越性和各证据层的互补价值。

Abstract: LLM-based personal agents are emerging as persistent carriers of user semantics and intermediaries between users and recommendation platforms, maintaining richer user knowledge locally. As agents interact with one another, the conventional \textit{User--Platform} relation evolves into a \textit{User--Agent Web--Platform} information pathway, enabling distributed user-side information to complement item-side information. This new pathway, however, defies conventional recommendation: evidence is scattered across mutually opaque agents and reachable only through bounded queries, only a small portion of it is relevant to the current recommendation decision, and the responses returned by different agents are semantically heterogeneous. We therefore recast recommendation over the agent web as a \emph{task-time evidence acquisition and fusion} problem under a finite evidence budget by deciding what to ask and what to keep, rather than learning from aggregated data. We propose AgentWebRec, a user-agent-oriented framework that progressively acquires and fuses distributed evidence for each user-item decision while keeping underlying agent memories local. It grounds each decision in platform-provided item semantics and task-relevant evidence from the target user agent's private memory, and conditionally queries neighboring user agents for complementary preference patterns when local evidence is insufficient. Experiments on four InstructRec datasets show that AgentWebRec consistently outperforms baseline recommenders, and ablations verify that the evidence layers contribute complementary gains.

</details>


### [123] [Optimizing Effective Training Time for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02057)
*Mingming Ding,Ruilin Chen,Yuzhen Huang,Hang Qi,Menglu Yu,San Tan,Damian Reeves,Boris Sarana,Kevin Tang,Satendra Gera,Gagan Jain,Sahil Shah,Vishwa Karia,Fuzail Khan,Yashasvi Makin,Edward Z. Yang,Oguz Ulgen,Jia Chen Ren,Laith Sakka,Mayank Garg,Meet Vadakkanchery,Aici Lin,Wei Sun,Mengjiao Zhou,Shuai Yang,Junqing Zhou,Max Leung,Apoorv Purwar,Musharaf Sultan,John Bocharov,Zhenyu Tang,Vivek Trehan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文针对大规模推荐模型训练集群中的生命周期开销问题，提出有效训练时间（ETT%）框架量化并定位开销，通过全栈优化（通信消除、流水线重叠、动态形状处理、编译缓存复用、异步检查点等）将最大负载的ETT%从50-60%提升至85%，车队整体从约80%提升至90%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模推荐训练集群中，生命周期开销默默吞噬加速器算力，最大负载仅有50-60%的端到端墙钟时间用于实际训练新数据，亟需系统性研究并优化全栈训练流程以提升硬件利用率。

Method: 采用ETT%作为运营框架，插桩测量损耗时间、定位到独立基础设施组件、揭露作业重启间的重复工作；指导优化涵盖训练器初始化时的通信消除与流水线重叠、动态形状处理/自动调优剪枝/可复用PyTorch 2编译缓存、异步检查点、独立模型发布、降低恢复成本等全栈技术。

Result: 在代表性模型上评估，所有基准的ETT%均提升，平均提升15.5%，最大负载达到85%；部署后车队级ETT%从约80%升至90%以上。

Conclusion: 通过系统化的全栈优化，显著降低了大规模推荐训练的生命周期开销，大幅提升了集群级有效训练时间比例，验证了ETT%驱动的优化方法论在生产环境中的有效性。

Abstract: Lifecycle overhead silently consumes accelerator capacity across large-scale recommendation training fleets. Our largest recommendation workloads process tens of billions train- ing examples per day on thousands of GPUs. Before this work, only 50-60% of their end-to-end wall time advanced training on new data. We present a fleet-scale study of this lifecycle overhead and a set of optimizations spanning the full training stack. We use Effective Training Time (ETT%) as an operational framework to instrument lost time, localize it to independently owned infrastructure components, and expose work repeated across job restarts. This analysis guides optimizations like communication elimination and pipeline overlap during trainer initialization; dynamic-shape handling, autotuning pruning, and reusable Py- Torch 2 compilation caches; asynchronous checkpointing; stan- dalone model publishing; and reductions in recovery cost. We evaluate the optimizations on representative models and measure their impacts in our training fleet. ETT% improves on every benchmark, by 15.5% on average, and reaches 85% on our largest workload. Fleet-wide ETT% rose from about 80% to above 90% after deployment.

</details>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [124] [Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究长时程语言智能体的外部记忆使用模式，发现记忆检索呈现核心-长尾分布，并提出基于秩的记忆控制器CTWM，通过单一指数τ分配提示预算，在保持精度的前提下显著减少token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时程语言智能体依赖外部记忆作为冻结世界模型，但当前记忆系统仅按任务成功率或token成本评估，忽略了记忆使用的形状：在有限上下文和重复检索下，记忆会集中于少数核心状态，而罕见状态形成长尾并积累预测误差。

Method: 通过保守尾部审计分析不同策略下的记忆检索分布：随机游走智能体产生对数正态分布兼容的检索伪影，语义LLM策略产生最强的截断幂律兼容核心-长尾轨迹。基于此提出核心-长尾世界模型（CTWM），一种基于秩的记忆控制器，用单一指数τ分配提示预算并保留摘要化的长尾。

Result: 在合成图世界中，CTWM保持完整状态和转移覆盖，较图记忆基线减少5.9%提示token，降低底部一半长尾预测误差13.6%。在ALFWorld保持一致token节省，在LongMemEval实现24.48% token减少且聚合准确率持平。

Conclusion: 重尾记忆轨迹不仅是有限检索的诊断指标，更是token高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号。CTWM通过单一指数参数即可实现核心-长尾记忆的高效分配，为长时程智能体记忆管理提供了新范式。

Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

</details>


### [125] [When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FedCausalCompose 是一个针对模块化 LLM 代理的因果世界模型框架，研究表明：仅当跨模块接口在统计上可识别且以代理在行动时可用的形式呈现时，因果结构才能帮助干预性规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 代理越来越多地通过模块化系统（如订单、支付、库存、发货服务）行动，一个模块的动作会改变另一个模块的有效转换。标准世界模型拟合观测轨迹，但这不足以支持干预时的规划：观测数据可能显示支付先于发货，却无法识别支付是否授权发货、库存是否中介该效应，或隐藏触发因素解释两者。因此存在观测模型与干预规划需求之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出 FedCausalCompose 因果世界模型框架，利用局部动作提供的干预-响应证据恢复跨模块接口。理论上证明：观测世界模型在未阻塞后门路径下存在不可约的干预误差；接口恢复随干预-响应覆盖度提升而改善；当覆盖度和局部机制误差受控时，神谕因果组合能超越非因果下界。在诊断代理设置中实证测试。

Result: 因果接口在结构化工具环境中帮助最大，API 签名暴露前置条件和下游效应。相反，在对话和叙事环境中，除非短注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关，否则原始边列表常被忽略。

Conclusion: 为 LLM 代理中的因果世界模型确立了具体适用条件：当跨模块接口既在统计上可识别，又以代理在行动时可使用的形式呈现时，因果结构才有助于干预性规划。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

</details>


### [126] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Praxa，一种显式表示 LLM 代理中提议、权威、分派、验证外部效果和服务晋升等状态的代理框架，通过确定性准入、代理执行、外部回读、协调和评审晋升实现。四条证据通道显示：本地审计通过所有测试但无独立复现；Terminal-Bench 试点中可靠性层未显示优势；协调代理开发对比中候选方案使用更少资源但未证明质量提升；部署证据显示有界反射等能力但无生产效益提升。当前证据未确立对抗安全、生产安全、专家优势、自主递归优化或用户收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理在提出和执行动作时，提议、权威、分派、验证外部效果和服务晋升等状态往往混淆，缺乏显式表示和可测试的架构，导致难以验证代理行为的正确性和安全性。

Method: 设计 Praxa 代理框架，通过五个核心机制显式建模状态转换：确定性准入、代理执行、外部回读、协调和评审晋升。并通过四条证据通道评估：本地仓库审计、Terminal-Bench Core 试点、协调代理开发对比、部署源码/配置证据。

Result: 1) 本地审计通过 1027/1027 单元测试和 89/89 Workerd 测试，覆盖 363 个源文件，满足四个覆盖率下限，但缺乏原始逐测试记录和独立复现。2) Terminal-Bench 12 任务试点中基线和可靠性层均通过 17/36 严格试验，可靠性层消耗 37.49% 更多输入和 50.73% 更多输出 token，不支持优势性。3) 协调代理开发对比中基线和候选方案均完成 180/180 试验，准确率相等，候选方案少用 37.11% token、33.84% 更低估算成本、11.63% 更少步骤，但未证明质量、延迟或生产行为改进。4) 部署证据显示有界反射、回忆核算、记忆编译和工具健康路径，但无生产结果提升。

Conclusion: Praxa 的核心贡献是一个基于证据的架构，使权威到效果的转换显式化并可测试。当前证据不足以确立对抗安全性、生产安全性、通用专家优势、自主递归优化或用户收益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [127] [What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00018)
*Jiameng Zhang,Hongqiu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过消息干预诊断发现，在推理者到验证者的流程中，忠实理由对答案准确率提升微乎其微，而损坏的理由会显著改变支持判断；人类审计显示模型过度信任损坏理由。建议将理由共享视为验证消息机制评估，而非仅追求答案准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有角色专业化QA流程中，推理者向验证者传递理由，但不清楚这种传递实际带来什么收益：更好的答案、更强的支持评估，还是新的失败面。

Method: 提出消息干预诊断，固定证据和候选答案，仅改变跨推理者-验证者边界传递的理由。在MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA上用DeepSeek作为生成器和验证器进行实验，对比无理由、忠实理由、损坏理由、无害改写等条件，并进行人工审计和跨模型/任务边界检查。

Result: 忠实理由对答案准确率几乎无提升（相比无理由）；损坏理由强烈改变支持判断（盲验证器下损坏理由移动支持率10-22%，显式理由检查提示放大至34-55%）；最终答案变动较小（2-30%），仅2.9-35.3%的损坏支持翻转伴随答案改变；人工审计发现16/42有效损坏为过度信任案例，盲人类拒绝或标记不清9/10被模型接受的损坏理由。

Conclusion: 理由共享应作为验证消息机制来评估，而不仅仅是提高答案准确率的途径；揭示了理由通道在何时激活、放大、惰性或折叠进任务标签。

Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

</details>


### [128] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文评估了小语言模型（SLM）作为大语言模型（LLM）规划器周围微任务处理器的可行性，发现现成的SLM无法满足实践者定义的阈值，量化也无法弥补差距，建议将SLM置于满足置信区间阈值的基线之后，仅在基线失效时使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者想知道现成的SLM是否能满足微任务（如自动批准shell命令、写入记忆、选择工具、对历史轮次排序）的实践者定义阈值，以及失败原因和量化是否改变结果。

Method: 构建了包含4个微任务的基准，固定提示和自动指标，每个任务有预设阈值τ，锚定廉价非LLM基线，采用CI感知资格规则（置信界需超过τ）。测试Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B的FP16、贪婪解码、单一冻结提示、无微调配置。用logprob决策阈值诊断（T1/T3/T4）和上下文长度/级联探针（T2）区分能力缺陷与可通过调整解码阈值解决的失败。评估4位量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）影响。在Llama-3.x上复现，进行τ扫描和提示改写鲁棒性测试。

Result: 16个配置（4任务×4模型）均未通过资格检查。失败分为能力缺陷和可通过调整解码阈值解决的4种模式。量化损害随模型大小变化，无配置进入资格；差距主要取决于模型规模而非精度。在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），对锚点选择和提示措辞鲁棒（0/112合格）。实际案例：4B重排序器在BM25候选集上优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但自身不满足资格。

Conclusion: SLM不应直接替代基线，而应部署在满足CI支持阈值的基线之后，仅在基线未达标时介入；需建立可靠的基线和回退机制。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [129] [Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00047)
*Khawaja Murad ul Hassan,Mehran Ebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PPFG（PRM修剪片段移植）在多个模型和基准上与独立并行CoT基线统计无差异，仅14%注入事件针对真正困难链，随机控制也表现相同，等价性测试确认无增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决并行思维链中的多样性崩塌问题，通过PRM修剪片段移植实现跨轨迹步级迁移，测试其在最小操作化下的有效性。

Method: 提出PPFG机制，在停滞和随机两种目标策略下，将高PRM前缀作为上下文演示移植给仍在解码的同胞链；在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct配合Math-Shepherd于MATH500上实验，三种随机种子；进行四分桶分类分析322次停滞规则注入事件；跨三个基础LM、六个基准、第二个PRM、兼容性门限扫描复现；使用TOST等价性检验、事后神谕界定增益上限。

Result: PPFG与独立并行CoT基线在所有测量轴上统计无差异；仅14%注入事件针对真正困难链，其余落在已成功、近完成或PRM平台期链上；随机控制以2.4倍触发率达到相同平价；注入链以2.75倍匹配步率被修剪，但存活同胞反事实显示无群体级补偿；事后神谕限界单问题增益≤0.13个百分点；TOST分析在12个Qwen/LLaMA单元上确认正等价性。

Conclusion: PPFG作为跨轨迹步级迁移的最小操作化在测试操作点上无增益；贡献等价性测试模板用于建立推理时机制零假设，所有声明限定于测试操作点。

Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

</details>


### [130] [Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00061)
*Ruoming Jin,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Jianfeng Zhu,Ruixin Guo,Feodor Dragan,Lei Xu,Haixun Wang,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GAP-DPO，一种几何对齐的偏好优化方法，通过效用感知的配对选择和逐轮重生成控制分布偏移，解决个性化 LLM 中 DPO 配对选择启发式的问题，显著提升风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个性化 DPO 方法依赖启发式配对选择（如基于似然的极值），使优化脱离显式用户效用，导致个性化效果下降。需要从梯度几何角度形式化配对选择，使其成为优化几何的内在组件而非预处理步骤。

Method: 分析期望用户效用梯度与 DPO 更新方向的一阶交互，将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题。提出 GAP-DPO 算法：迭代进行效用感知、几何对齐的配对选择，并通过逐轮重生成控制分布偏移。

Result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO 相比标准 DPO 变体持续提升风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量。

Conclusion: 梯度对齐是个性化偏好优化的统一原则，配对选择是优化几何的内在组件而非启发式预处理步骤。GAP-DPO 验证了这一原则的有效性。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

</details>


### [131] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是一个免费开源的 AI 科研助手，运行在研究人员自己的电脑上，研究者自带模型（本地或托管），系统提供科学脚手架、完整记录和可复现的项目结构。它通过 Living Lab Notebook、只读审计日志、科学流程库等机制解决模型过度声称问题，在 20 个跨学科任务中超越两个托管平台，且唯一提供软件环境记录和结果再生命令。代码采用 MIT 许可开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对当前 AI 科研助手普遍存在的模型过度声称、缺乏可复现性、数据锁定在专有平台等问题，旨在提供一个研究者完全掌控、可审计、长期可读的本地化科研工作流工具。

Method: 1. 本地优先架构：项目即普通文件夹，数据、代码、结果、记录全本地保存。2. 科学脚手架：内置科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据目录、审稿人/撰稿人角色。3. Living Lab Notebook：条目链接成论证链，只增不删。4. 只读审计日志：通过观察智能体行为记录而非信任其自述，智能体无工具可写入日志。5. 自带模型（BYOK）：研究者接入任意本地或托管模型。

Result: 在预设评分标准下的 20 个跨学科科研提示词测试中，K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量和研究执行两个维度均领先两个托管平台。其交付物唯一包含运行软件的环境记录，且通常附带可一键再生结果的命令。对比平台即使使用同一前沿模型也未提供上述记录。环境记录目前为智能体写入的文件，尚未纳入观测日志。

Conclusion: K-Dense BYOK 通过本地化、可审计、结构化的设计有效缓解了模型过度声称问题，显著提升了科研任务的可复现性和执行质量，为科学研究提供了一个透明、可长期保存、研究者自主可控的 AI 辅助范式。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [132] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文评估了详细的专业特定系统提示（AGENTS.md配置文件）对Gemini 3.8 Flash模型在科学任务上的影响。实验表明，使用完整的专业配置文件并未提升准确率，反而显著增加了token消耗和成本，甚至在工具使用任务中降低了解决率。唯一优势是较长提示在API不稳定时提高了首次通过率，但这归因于提示长度而非领域专业知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着专业特定系统提示（如AGENTS.md）在AI代理中普及，需要实证评估其是否真正提升模型在科学任务上的表现，以及其带来的计算成本代价是否合理。

Method: 使用开源的503个专业特定AGENTS.md配置文件，在Pi代理框架下通过OpenRouter调用Gemini 3.8 Flash。在九个文本科学基准（4,531个问题，100个匹配配置文件）和BioMysteryBench生物信息学工具任务（60个问题）上，对比完整配置文件与四种控制条件：极简基线、配置文件首句角色描述、通用科学严谨指南、不相关领域配置文件。采用自动化规则评分，进行bootstrap统计分析。

Result: 1) 九个文本基准上，完整配置文件与基线准确率差异为-0.6个百分点（95% CI [-1.5, +0.2]），无基准显示显著提升。2) 配置文件输出token数为基线1.5-2.3倍，成本为2.2-4.5倍。3) BioMysteryBench上，配置文件解决率46.7% vs 基线56.7%，差异-10.0百分点（95% CI [-16.7, -3.3]），主要因token/时间限制中断增加。4) SuperGPQA上，配置文件首次通过率71.6% vs 基线54.0%，但通用和不匹配提示也有类似提升，表明源于提示长度/格式而非领域知识。

Conclusion: 在测试模型和任务下，默认加载完整专业配置文件不提升准确率且成本大幅增加；是否通过选择性检索配置文件片段或开放式科学任务能改变这一结论，尚待后续研究验证。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [133] [Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00791)
*Terry Dorsey,Kevin Huggins*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出企业表示简化(ERS)与企业表示复杂度(ERC)框架，定义四维复杂度模型(表示对象、交互、行为、支持源)及表现层/任务层度量，构建包含全局经常性成本、任务级经常性成本、一次性转换成本的经济模型，并证实降低任务级ERC能提升AI推理准确性(Text-to-SQL证据)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业信息由应用、项目、技术、组织边界和本地需求塑造的制品表示，随时间积累产生表示复杂性，企业需维护，信息消费者和AI系统需解读，缺乏跨表示状态比较复杂度的中立模型与量化评估方法。

Method: 提出ERC四维模型：表示对象、交互、行为构成依赖类别，支持源刻画表示暴露；在表示层和任务层定义ERC，区分架构简化与检索优化；建立生命周期义务经济模型，区分三类成本；引用Text-to-SQL研究验证任务级ERC降低对AI推理的影响。

Result: ERC提供可度量的架构变量，支持表示备选方案比较、转换效果评估、经济结果分析和AI推理性能预测；实证表明模式与推理复杂度降低可提升Text-to-SQL准确性。

Conclusion: ERC非通用复杂度/性能/成本指标，但为架构决策提供可量化变量，ERS通过降低不必要表示复杂性实现维护成本优化与AI推理效能提升的双重收益。

Abstract: Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states.
  ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization.
  The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy.
  ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.

</details>


### [134] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究对话幽默中语言模型的自动化奖励设计，揭示了两种奖励机制（基于嵌入的惊讶奖励和观众笑声预测模型）均存在可被利用的捷径，并尝试通过反制措施缓解，但最终强化学习训练的幽默专项提升仍未达预期目标，凸显自动化奖励设计中阻断捷径与保留目标行为的矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索自动化奖励在对话幽默训练中的有效性，重点分析奖励被利用（reward exploits）的现象及其对抗措施，以理解自动化奖励设计中的核心挑战。

Method: 采用两种奖励方法：基于嵌入的惊讶奖励和观众模型预测笑声奖励；通过受控实验测试奖励漏洞（如词序打乱回复、笑声线索注入）；引入流畅性过滤器和跨说话人笑声线索归一化作为反制措施；进行三轮强化学习训练，逐步修订奖励函数并评估效果。

Result: 嵌入惊讶奖励无法区分机智回复与词序打乱回复；流畅性过滤器虽能检测打乱，但组合奖励误拒部分机智回复且验证失败；观众模型易受笑声线索攻击，归一化可阻断已知攻击但未匹配表达仍可利用；最终RL运行使综合评分提升0.0903、零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项指标未达预注册目标。

Conclusion: 自动化奖励设计面临根本困境：反制措施必须同时堵塞可利用的捷径并保留奖励原本要鼓励的行为，二者往往相互制约，需更谨慎的奖励工程与评估体系。 }

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [135] [EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00212)
*Yixi Zhou,Sikun Wang,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 EviGraph 方法，通过区分关键决策需求与可容忍的未决信息，利用语言代理将需求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据，并用确定性检查器判断推荐是否得到支持，从而减少公共服务推荐中的不必要拒绝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共服务推荐需要证据匹配服务、范围和日期，但将每个缺失细节视为决定性因素会导致有用推荐被错误拒绝。现有方法缺乏区分关键需求与非关键信息的机制，造成过度拒绝。

Method: 引入 EviGraph 框架：1) 语言代理将关键决策需求映射到时序知识图谱中的证据；2) 确定性检查器根据证据判断推荐是否被支持；3) 在双语香港公共服务基准上评估，包含可执行的策略参考。

Result: 实验表明，区分关键需求显著减少不必要的拒绝；额外的验证步骤会撤回本已被支持的推荐，但并未提升决策质量。

Conclusion: 可靠的基于证据的导航取决于明确指定决策必须确立的内容，而非单纯增加验证步骤。

Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

</details>


### [136] [Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00224)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Build2SPARQL，一个面向建筑知识图谱（Brick、ASHRAE 223P）的大规模文本到SPARQL基准，通过图遍历代码生成并验证SPARQL查询，仅用LLM生成自然语言问题，确保查询正确性独立于模型行为。基准包含6种查询模式族、5种词汇寄存器，覆盖201个建筑KG，产出6,136条可执行SPARQL及30,680条问题。人工评估显示语义保真度98.8%、自然度98.8%、操作合理性84.0%。检索增强评估使三开源模型的精确匹配率从零样本的0.2-20%提升至三样本检索的56-65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑自动化系统越来越多地采用语义知识图谱（如Brick、ASHRAE 223P），为AI应用提供机器可读基础。将自然语言问题转为SPARQL（text-to-SPARQL）可让运维人员通过语言代理查询图谱，但进展受限于大规模自然语言/SPARQL基准的稀缺。

Method: 提出KG-grounded流水线：用图遍历代码生成并验证SPARQL查询（保证正确性），仅用LLM生成自然语言问题。挖掘六大查询模式族（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并用五种词汇寄存器改写每条查询。应用于201个建筑KG（180 Brick、21 ASHRAE 223P）。

Result: 获得6,136条可执行SPARQL查询和30,680条自然语言问题。双评分者人工验证300条问题：语义保真度98.8%、自然度98.8%、操作合理性84.0%。在三个开源权重模型上进行检索增强评估，精确匹配准确率从零样本的0.2-20%提升至三样本检索的56-65%。

Conclusion: Build2SPARQL为建筑领域text-to-SPARQL提供了首个大规模、高质量、查询正确性有保证的基准。实验表明检索增强能显著提升开源模型性能，但仍有提升空间，为后续研究奠定了坚实基础。

Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

</details>


### [137] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究在受限信令通道中面对知情对手时的最优信号选择问题，发现对手稳健最优信号与显著性极点高度一致；随着对手说服预算增加，最优信号从后验概率最大化转向边际最大化。实验表明语言模型在对手感知评估中存在结构性局限，无法区分向稳健最优还是显著性启发式的移动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在存在知情对手且共享受众的约束信令通道中，如何选择能最好保护真相的信号。旨在理解对手预算对最优信号策略的影响，以及现有显著性启发式与贝叶斯判别在对手稳健性下的关系。

Method: 引入对手到强制选择任务中（改编自《欺骗：香港谋杀案》），对手知晓目标、观察信号并利用说服预算β为最强错误答案辩护。通过108个确证性项目和20万项目池实验，分析最优信号随β变化的轨迹，并测试七个语言模型在两种对手框架下的表现。

Result: 1) 对手稳健最优在108项目上与显著性极点完全一致，在20万项目池中仅2,748个项目差异（位于显著性到贝叶斯坐标未定义处)。2) 随β增长，最优信号从后验最大化转向边际最大化；β=0时复现原预言机模型（监听者温度τ=1)。3) 18.2%项目池的最优在有限预算下发生转移，每个项目的临界预算精确。4) 两种对手框架使七个语言模型在108项目上有30-77个项目改变选择，但无法测量这种移动是向对手感知最优还是向显著性，因为两者选项完全相同——这是结构性极限而非空结果。

Conclusion: 对手稳健性通过完全从贝叶斯判别转向显著性来实现。评估对手感知能力前，必须先通过廉价诊断检查验证稳健目标是否与启发式目标在评估项目上重合，否则无法区分模型是真正学会对手感知还是仅退回显著性启发式。

Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

</details>


### [138] [Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01533)
*Aleksei Medvedev,Alejandro Ariza-Casabona,Steven Derby,Gonzalo Fiz Pontiveros,Xinyang Shao,Florian Spiess*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种统一的图感知语义ID框架，将SID构建重构为递归图分区问题，并展示了两种实例化方法在真实数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将SID构建视为表示学习的方法忽略了协同信号与语义内容的结合，本文认为SID构建本质是递归聚类问题，需融合语义内容和协同信号的图结构。

Method: 提出GrIS框架，将SID分配建模为层次化图分区，包含两个可配置轴：图构建和递归分区算法。实例化RecDMoN（基于可微图池化的层次分配）和RQ-GAE（扩展RQ-VAE引入图感知表示和图重构目标）。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上，GrIS持续优于CF感知SOTA，Hit@10最高提升52%。图构建和分区的显式解耦使得改进可系统组合评估。

Conclusion: 将SID构建重构为递归图分区问题，统一了现有方法并开辟了更大设计空间，显式分离图构建与分区算法两个轴，为后续研究提供系统框架。

Abstract: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically.

</details>


### [139] [Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00234)
*Wenhui Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究学习率调度如何作为平均算子决定模型在两种不兼容但正确约定之间的选择。通过理论证明和实验（10种数据顺序、固定预算、仅改变lr_scheduler_type），发现：常数学习率下顺序效应强（分配跨度0.2221，对比度11.63，随块状程度单调）；余弦衰减下同10个实验仅占2个可辨状态。两种约定的准确率之和恒定（±9.7%），但分配份额从0.04到0.87剧烈变化，12.29-sigma的顺序切换在约定无关指标下为零。在提示中标记约定可消除切换并达到联合上限87.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究模型在面对两种不兼容但均正确的约定时，数据呈现顺序如何通过学习率调度这一平均算子写入参数，以及为何常规基准无法捕捉这种约定层面的选择。

Method: 1. 理论证明：给出界限，将排列效应分解为排列因子（块周期）与调度因子（端点权重）的乘积。2. 受控实验：同一语料库的10种顺序、相同预算、仅路径不同，在仅lr_scheduler_type不同（常数率vs余弦衰减）的两族实验中各跑两遍。测量分配份额、对比度下界、准确率守恒等。

Result: 常数学习率下：内部分配跨度0.2221，11.63对比度下界，随排列块状程度单调变化。余弦衰减下：同10个实验仅占2个可辨状态（理论分辨率约10个）。12个实验臂中acc_A+acc_B在9.7%内守恒，但分配份额从0.04跨越到0.87，12.29-sigma的排列切换在约定无关指标下为零。提示中标记约定使切换消失并达到联合上限87.5%。

Conclusion: 学习率调度是控制顺序效应的核心旋钮，决定模型承诺哪种约定。衰减调度通过分离排列与调度因子来抑制顺序效应。常规精确匹配基准无法看到约定层面的选择，显式提示约定可恢复性能。

Abstract: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

</details>


### [140] [Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00282)
*Yezhou Cheng,Runjia Du,Zeming Liu,Hang Lyu,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 GAVA 框架，用于具身智能体在面对可能错误的人类纠正时进行仲裁决策（接受、拒绝、环境核查、询问澄清），并在 ALFWorld 文本环境中通过实验验证了选择性信息收集结合语义先验能降低交互成本，但未证明环境信息价值相对于澄清询问的普遍优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是解决具身智能体在接收人类纠正指令时，如何判断纠正是否可信并决定相应行动的问题，即“基础纠正仲裁”问题。

Method: 提出 GAVA（Grounded Arbitration with Verification Actions）框架，将仲裁建模为四选一决策：接受、拒绝、环境核查、询问澄清。GAVA 使用观测受限证据、合法探测和单步期望损失规则实现该接口。在仅文本的 ALFWorld 环境中，使用 162 个检查点生成 972 对真/假干预对进行评估；引入探索性训练仅物体位置先验，并冻结策略后在不重叠的 77 个检查点（308 场景）复现增益。

Result: 完全局部核查使 GAVA 和 always-verify 都达到 100% 纠正准确率。同回合执行中，GAVA 相比 always-verify 降低交互成本，但在完美说话者下与成本阈值持平。引入物体位置先验后，在 340 个未见场景上交互成本和联合声明成本分别降低 0.490 和 0.420；冻结策略后在 308 个已见场景上复现增益 0.595 和 0.517（95% CI 不含零）。联合成本优于相同先验的固定策略，但与校准后的无 VOI 基线比较无定论。语义 GAVA 每组犯 4 个事实错误，准确率 98.8% 和 98.7%，所有方法均完成全部任务。

Conclusion: 结果支持在声明成本下结合语义先验进行选择性信息收集，但未建立环境信息价值（VOI）相对于澄清询问的普遍优势。研究使用归一化声明、完整符号观测和受控说话者，未涉及人类参与者、视觉输入或物理机器人。

Abstract: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. After freezing the policy, costs, baselines, and multiplicity plan, the gains replicate on 77 non-overlapping seen checkpoints, covering 308 scenarios: 0.595 and 0.517, with both 95 percent checkpoint-bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. Joint cost also improves over an identical-prior fixed policy, while the matched calibrated no-VOI comparison remains inconclusive. Semantic GAVA makes four factual errors in each cohort, corresponding to 98.8 percent and 98.7 percent accuracy, and all methods complete every task. Results support selective information gathering with semantic priors under declared costs, but do not establish a general advantage of environmental value of information over clarification. The study uses normalized claims, complete symbolic observations, and controlled speakers; it evaluates neither human participants, visual input, nor physical robots.

</details>


### [141] [ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02202)
*Sohyeon Kim,Yoonho Lee,Bo Liu,Dayoon Ko,Rulin Shao,Seungone Kim,Graham Neubig,Pang Wei Koh,Aakanksha Chowdhery,Akari Asai,Omar Khattab,Yejin Choi,Gunhee Kim,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建了ScholarCatalyst数据集，研究科学家如何从海量文献中检索关键先前工作，评估了智能体搜索与嵌入检索的效果，发现即使强模型也难以匹配专家直觉，呼吁新训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究科学家识别关键先前工作的能力，旨在开发能从半成型想法出发推荐相关文献的科学智能体。

Method: 收集184位首席作者对207篇近期计算机科学论文的标注，构建ScholarCatalyst数据集；设计检索任务：给定初始研究问题，仅从项目开始时可用的文献中检索作者标注的相关论文；对比智能体搜索、嵌入检索及Claude Fable 5.1等方法的表现。

Result: 智能体搜索Recall@20为0.42，嵌入检索为0.48，Claude Fable 5.1仅达0.51，均远低于专家水平，表明当前模型缺乏专家级检索直觉。

Conclusion: 需要新的训练范式赋予模型专家级文献检索直觉，ScholarCatalyst为开发能从早期想法推荐关键先前工作的科学智能体奠定基础。

Abstract: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

</details>


### [142] [Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00313)
*Jingjie Ning,Guojiang Zhao,Chen Xu,Shanshan Zhong,Xiaochuan Li,Ji Zeng,Guolin Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: R2T 方法为科学编码代理提供预制可执行检查，在代码修复任务中，工具组与文本组表现接近，工具组在部分任务优势明显，但整体差异不显著，且工具组模型输出量减少 31.2%，CPU 使用增加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学编码代理需根据文字描述的方程、边界条件和输出要求编写并评估程序，现有方法依赖纯文本规范，缺乏可执行的验证手段，导致修复效果依赖任务且难以量化。

Method: 提出 Rules to Tools (R2T) 框架，将公开科学需求转为可调用的可执行检查。构建匹配的 SciCode 修复组：文本组接收书面检查，工具组接收可调用实现。在两个任务 ID 队列（30 任务、16 任务）、共享定义队列（24 任务）、开发暴露任务（5 任务）及 PDE 对比实验中对比修复完成率、模型输出量及 CPU 使用。

Result: 30 任务队列：工具组 29/30，文本组 26/30；16 任务队列：工具组 15/16，文本组 13/16（差异 95% CI [-12.5, 43.75]%）；共享定义队列两组均 13/24；开发暴露任务工具组 7/10 对文本组 3/10。PDE 对比中详细文本 23/24，检查 24/24，工具组模型输出降低 31.2%。代理侧输出节省随队列变化，公共 CPU 使用在两任务队列均上升。

Conclusion: R2T 提供的预制检查能显著提升特定任务的修复成功率，整体修复率与详细文本规范相当，但能大幅减少模型输出量（31.2%），代价是 CPU 资源消耗增加。修复效果呈强任务依赖性，工具优势集中在少数任务，多数任务两组打平。

Abstract: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor tools, one favors text, and eleven tie. The eight-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points for the difference. The larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24 per group. Five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The tool group favors tasks 17, 77, and 11; initial checks flag task 17 and report no violation for tasks 77 and 11. Task 37 favors text and has no initial reported violation. A fresh source-through-Python arm also reaches 15/16, matching the dedicated command's aggregate. In a matched PDE comparison, detailed text scores 23/24 and checks score 24/24, with 31.2% lower reported model output for checks. Agent-side output savings vary by cohort, while public CPU use rises in both task-ID cohorts. These results measure task-dependent repair outcomes and agent-side costs with prepared checks.

</details>


### [143] [Predictive Credit: Measuring What Scientific Explanations Add to Experimental Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00314)
*Jingjie Ning,Xueqi Li,Yibo Kong,Dongting Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究评估研究代理解释实验计划时的预测信用度，通过配对预测对比描述、匹配解释和捐赠者上下文，在Tox21和OpenML任务上测试多个模型，结果显示自然语言解释的预测信用度在测试分辨率下未得到确认。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在量化研究代理（如大语言模型）在解释计划实验时提供的预测价值，建立衡量科学预测和研究代理基准的协议，验证自然语言解释是否能实质性提升预测准确性。

Method: 采用配对预测设计，控制干预、预测者和结果变量，仅变化描述、匹配解释和捐赠者上下文。通过五项检查（承诺、交付、预测增益、对齐、已知信号采纳）评估。在336个前瞻状态、12个Tox21终点和24个OpenML任务上测试冻结的v5信用决策，并对比DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash、研究人员撰写的机制正向对照等条件。

Result: 主要结果均为非显著或未达标：Tox21预注册ROC AUC区间分数损害检验未通过（D-M=-0.0026，95% CI [-0.0174, 0.0104]）；OpenML联合形成、点等价性和重复性规则未通过；匹配点准确率增益未确认；种子-捐赠者区间跨越零。DeepSeek V4 Pro下匹配卡和捐赠者卡分别减少次级Tox21漂移64.5%和59.1%；但Flash重放使匹配点MAE从0.01823升至0.02020，未达匹配-捐赠者区间分数等价性。OpenML完整卡分配使名义80%区间扩大21%，覆盖率49.3%对比描述+内容的51.4%（66/144卡）。直接文本Flash交付全部144条注释但无可检测匹配点准确率增益。研究人员撰写的机制正向对照使点MAE降低2.60个百分点。

Conclusion: 该协议成功建立了研究代理基准和科学预测的预测信用度度量框架，但在测试的捐赠者分辨率下，自然语言解释的预测信用度未得到确认。研究人员撰写的机制解释显示出显著改善，提示未来需优化解释生成质量或提升评估灵敏度。

Abstract: Research agents explain planned experiments. We measure predictive credit with paired forecasts sharing an intervention, forecaster, and outcome while varying description, matched explanation, and donor context. Five checks track commitment, delivery, predictive gain, alignment, and known-signal uptake. Across 336 prospective states in controlled learning, 12 Tox21 endpoints, and 24 OpenML tasks, v5's frozen credit decision was inconclusive. Tox21's preregistered ROC AUC interval-score harm test was unmet ($D-M=-.0026$, 95 percent interval [$-.0174$, .0104]); OpenML's joint formation, point-equivalence, and repeatability rule was unmet. Matched point-accuracy gains over description remained unconfirmed, and Tox21/OpenML seed-donor intervals spanned zero. Under requested DeepSeek V4 Pro, matched and donor cards reduced secondary Tox21 drift by 64.5 and 59.1 percent. A DeepSeek V4 Flash replay raised matched point MAE from .01823 to .02020 and missed matched-donor interval-score equivalence. OpenML full-card assignment widened nominal 80 percent intervals by 21 percent, with 49.3 percent coverage versus 51.4 percent for description and content in 66/144 cards. Direct-text Flash delivered all 144 notes without detectable matched point-accuracy gain. A researcher-authored mechanism positive control lowered point MAE by 2.60 percentage points versus description. The protocol measures predictive credit for research-agent benchmarks and scientific forecasting; natural-explanation credit remained unconfirmed at the tested donor resolutions.

</details>


### [144] [ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00328)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Yina Sa,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 ContractRL，一种基于契约约束的序列化修复协议，将验证器引导的 JSON 修复建模为有界决策过程，通过动作掩码过滤非法 RFC-6902 操作，在语义成功率、生成 token 效率和修复可审计性上显著优于全量重生成和 Patch-SFT 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化工具调用常因少量字段违反模式或执行契约而失败，全量重生成会扩大动作空间且难以反复审计；现有补丁方法缺乏契约约束的序列化决策机制，导致修复效率低、成功率不足。

Method: ContractRL 将修复建模为有界决策过程：策略在每一步观测候选对象、类型化验证器反馈、JSON Pointer、不可变修复历史和剩余预算；契约衍生的动作掩码在确定性验证器执行转移前过滤掉非法或被禁止的 RFC-6902 操作；采用契约约束的群体相对目标优化补丁、重试和弃权决策，规范目标和语义标签在轨迹冻结前保持在离线状态。
