Result: 主要发现：1) 块旁路响应保持可识别的深度排序，但幅度发生重新分布；2) 邻近检查点比遥远检查点保持更强的秩对应性；3) 大幅度变化集中在跨文本样本复现且跨评估域迁移的位置；4) 自然旁路效应的变化不可简化为单一下游敏感性——Pythia中局部缺失更新幅度增长而池化匹配下游响应下降，OLMo-2 7B表现不同平衡；5) 匹配响应依赖扰动强度和方向，未发现针对性补偿机制。

Conclusion: 纵向层敏感性具有结构但非静态。单检查点干预响应应在底层扰动路径随训练演变的背景下解读，不能视为固定不变的模型组织特征。

Abstract: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. Controlled experiments further show that changes in the natural bypass effect cannot be reduced to a single downstream sensitivity: in replicated Pythia runs, local missing-update magnitude grows while the pooled matched downstream response decreases, whereas OLMo-2 7B exhibits a different balance. These matched responses also depend on perturbation strength and direction, without identifying targeted compensation. Together, our results show that longitudinal layer sensitivity is structured but not static, and that single-checkpoint intervention responses should be interpreted in the context of how the underlying perturbation pathway evolves during training.

</details>


### [414] [GLoC-EHR: Evidence-Cited Clinical Reasoning over Global Context and Local EHR Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01076)
*Chaiho Shin,Kwangsoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GLoC-EHR 是一种多模态语言模型，通过全局记忆（轨迹上下文）和局部记忆（选定事件）读取结构化电子健康记录（EHR），支持证据引用的临床问答，在 MIMIC-IV 任务上达到最高宏平均 AUROC，并能无需重训练迁移至新任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化 EHR 以临床编码序列记录患者临床轨迹，回答临床问题需要兼顾整体轨迹上下文与支持答案的具体事件。现有零样本大模型直接阅读序列化记录效果远不如预期，缺乏有效的证据定位与引用机制。

Method: GLoC-EHR 采用固定大小的全局记忆编码整条轨迹，局部记忆存储选定事件。模型先通过生成住院病程摘要（全局记忆）和被遮蔽概念描述（局部记忆）与临床文本对齐，再经理由据微调和组相对策略优化（GRPO），以正确答案和记录支持的证据为奖励训练证据引用能力。

Result: 在三个 MIMIC-IV 结局预测任务中，GLoC-EHR 直接作答的宏平均 AUROC 最高，零样本大模型大幅落后。引入证据引用推理后，宏平均 AUROC 与直接多任务基线接近；证据目标项在相似 AUROC 下减少无支持证据。局部记忆在严格匹配下增加独特支持发现，且不改变宏平均 AUROC。无需重训练即可迁移至 EHRSHOT，表现与 EHR-BERT 持平，且在两个未见实验室问题上优于同主干模型的零样本提示。

Conclusion: GLoC-EHR 通过全局-局部双记忆架构有效融合轨迹上下文与关键事件，实现了最优的临床结局预测性能、可解释的证据引用能力及零样本跨任务迁移，为结构化 EHR 的临床问答提供了实用范式。

Abstract: Structured electronic health records (EHRs) contain a patient's clinical trajectory as a sequence of clinical codes. Answering clinical questions from such records requires both the context of the whole trajectory and the specific events that support the answer. We introduce GLoC-EHR, a multimodal language model that reads a contextual encoding of the record through a fixed-size global memory of the trajectory and a local memory of selected events. The model learns to generate hospital-course summaries from the global memory and descriptions of masked concepts from the local memory, aligning both with clinical text. It is then trained to cite evidence before answering, through rationale fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with rewards for correct answers and record-supported evidence. On three MIMIC-IV outcome tasks, GLoC-EHR attains the highest macro AUROC among the compared models when it answers directly, whereas zero-shot LLMs reading the serialized record fall far behind. With evidence-cited reasoning, it stays close to its direct multi-task counterpart in macro AUROC, and the evidence terms of the objective reduce unsupported evidence at a similar macro AUROC. The local memory adds distinct supported findings, particularly under strict matching, without a detectable change in macro AUROC. Without retraining, GLoC-EHR transfers to EHRSHOT on par with EHR-BERT and answers two unseen laboratory questions better than zero-shot prompting of its own backbone.

</details>


### [415] [Dataset Identity, Not Novelty: The Source of an Inflated OOD Detection Gain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01096)
*Donghoon Lee,Shinjin Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了当前后验OOD检测器评估协议存在根本缺陷：在特定OOD数据集上拟合并验证会导致检测器学习数据集身份而非真正的新颖性，造成性能指标虚高（inflation）。作者提出整体数据集留出协议测量这种膨胀，发现大多数报告的增益源于数据集身份识别，并给出了闭式解预测膨胀程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前OOD检测评估协议允许在特定OOD数据集上拟合参数（如特征空间方向、灵活组合器），并在同一数据集的留出样本上验证。这种协议无法区分检测器是学会了识别新颖性还是仅仅记住了该特定OOD数据集的身份特征。实际部署时面对的OOD数据源未参与拟合，因此报告的性能增益可能完全失效。

Method: 1. 提出整体OOD数据集留出协议（而非样本留出）来测量膨胀量。 2. 在ImageNet和CIFAR-100骨干网络上，跨多种组合器测量膨胀。 3. 通过控制输入是否暴露类别身份的两个实验分离膨胀来源。 4. 推导闭式公式从拟合行计算膨胀，无需运行留出协议即可预测哪些拟合会膨胀。

Result: 1. 常规协议报告的大部分增益实为数据集身份识别而非新颖性检测。 2. 拟合规模不影响幸存性能，说明非普通过拟合。 3. 膨胀份额取决于输入是否暴露类别身份，两个仅改变该属性的控制实验在所有骨干上均分离出膨胀。 4. 闭式解准确预测膨胀。 5. 唯一幸存的拟合是领域已在指定验证集上选取的单一常数；更复杂的拟合报告增益但留出协议不返回，甚至在某基准上幸存性能下降而报告性能上升。

Conclusion: 当前OOD检测评估协议严重高估性能，实践者应仅使用单一常数拟合（在指定验证集上调优），更复杂的拟合虽报告更高指标但无法泛化到未见OOD数据。作者提供的闭式解可作为诊断工具预测膨胀风险。

Abstract: A post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detector reads the activations of a trained classifier and returns a score. It fits that score on in-distribution data, and the benchmarks that evaluate it supply a second piece of OOD data for the fitting itself. Some detectors tune a constant on it. Others fit a direction in feature space or train a flexible combiner and report the number that it reaches as the gain that is still available. Every such fit is validated on held-out samples of the same OOD dataset. That check rules out memorizing individual images. It says nothing about a fit that has instead learned which dataset it is looking at, and a direction that recognizes one OOD dataset rather than novelty passes it perfectly. The detector that a practitioner installs meets OOD data from a source that nobody fitted it on, so the difference decides what the reported number is worth. We measure it by holding out the whole OOD dataset rather than a sample of it, and we call that gap the inflation. We read it across a range of combiners on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 backbones. Most of the gain that the usual protocol reports turns out to be dataset identity rather than novelty. The size of the fit does not move what survives, so the effect is not ordinary overfitting. The share depends instead on whether the input exposes class identity, and two controls that vary that property alone separate the inflation on every backbone of both benchmarks. A closed form accounts for the effect and computes it from the fitting rows, so a practitioner can tell which fits will inflate without running the hold-out protocol. One of these fits survives, namely the single constant that the field already picks on a designated validation dataset. Anything above it reports a gain that the hold-out protocol does not return, and on one benchmark what survives falls while what is reported climbs.

</details>


### [416] [How Much Can Language Models Gain from Test-Time Computation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01110)
*Bangji Yang,Jingyuan Li,Jiajun Fan,Yi Evie Zhang,Ruihan Guo,Hongba Ma,Neil He,Chumeng Liang,Qinglong Zheng,Zhanghan Ni,Ge Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出SELF-POT基准框架，系统评估测试时计算扩展在数学、编程和智能体任务中的效果，统一预算规则下对比直接推理、并行采样和自我修正，量化选择策略和失败处理对性能提升的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展研究多单领域评估，且忽略选择成本，缺乏统一预算下的跨领域对比框架，无法量化额外推理的边际收益及低成本模型与强模型的权衡。

Method: 构建SELF-POT基准，包含竞赛数学、竞技编程、智能体工作流三大领域350个密封任务。分离候选覆盖率与最终准确率，追踪修正下的正确性转移，测量协议完成度与任务成功率。统一预算规则：以Direct推理为基准，固定倍数预算对比并行采样和自我修正，所有模型调用（含选择、评判）按美元计费。以Claude Opus 5.5 Direct为参考，评估五个低成本推理模型。

Result: 收益取决于领域、选择规则、失败处理。编程任务：公共示例选择使500个调度单元中正确提交从376增至453，节省12-49%逻辑API成本；评判失败时保留可用候选可零成本恢复61次提交。数学任务：带回退的评判得186正确提交，投票得182，但投票节省12-21%成本。受控重放显示选择与失败处理如何改变同一候选池的收益，量化了模型评判器的边际价值。

Conclusion: SELF-POT提供了统一、可复现的测试时扩展评估框架，揭示了选择策略和失败处理对实现生成候选潜力的关键作用，为模型部署中的成本-性能权衡提供了量化依据。

Abstract: How much can test-time computation improve a language model, and at what cost? Test-time scaling is widely proposed as a substitute for larger models, but existing comparisons mostly evaluate one domain at a time and rarely charge selection to the budget. We introduce SELF-POT, a benchmark and evaluation framework that measures the test-time potential of a model across competition mathematics, competitive programming, and agentic workflows. SELF-POT separates candidate coverage from final accuracy on static tasks, tracks correctness transitions under revision, and measures protocol completion alongside task success in agentic environments. Under a unified budget rule, it compares Direct inference with parallel sampling and self-revision under fixed multiples of the Direct budget, and charges every model call, including selection and critique, in dollars. This design supports two kinds of comparison: the gain a model obtains from additional inference, and a lower-cost model with additional inference against a stronger model. Across five low-cost reasoning models on 350 sealed tasks, with Claude Opus 5.5 Direct as the reference, the returns depend on the domain, the selection rule, and failure handling. When we replay the retained programming candidate pools, public-example selection raises correct submissions from 376 to 453 of 500 scheduled cells while saving 12-49% of logical API cost across models, and simply retaining an available candidate when judging fails recovers 61 submissions at unchanged cost. On identical mathematics pools, judging with fallback yields 186 correct submissions versus 182 for voting, while voting saves 12-21% of logical API cost. These controlled replays show how selection and failure handling change the gains realized from the same generated candidates, and they quantify the marginal value of a model judge.

</details>


### [417] [Latent Information Sharing for Accelerating Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01126)
*Seungjun Lee,Ensieh Khazaei,Dimitrios Hatzinakos,Baturalp Buyukates,Sunwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种潜在信息共享方案，通过共享少量隐层激活值来缓解联邦学习中的客户端漂移问题，提升训练效率且保持收敛保证和数据隐私。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中数据异质性导致客户端漂移，阻碍全局模型高效训练，现有方法如FedProx、SCAFFOLD等虽缓解但仍有局限，需新方案直接解决数据异质性。

Method: 提出潜在信息共享机制，客户端上传少量隐层激活值而非原始数据或完整模型，服务端聚合这些激活值以指导全局模型更新，理论分析其对收敛和隐私的影响。

Result: 实验表明，在固定通信轮数下，该方法在模型准确率上优于FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto和SplitFed等基线，且通信开销不显著增加。

Conclusion: 隐层激活共享是一种有前景的知识聚合范式，能有效缓解客户端漂移，兼顾训练效率、收敛保证和隐私保护，为联邦优化提供新视角。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a communication-efficient distributed learning paradigm. However, client drift remains one of the most critical challenges, hindering the efficient training of a global model. In this study, we propose a novel latent information sharing scheme that directly mitigates data heterogeneity across clients. Our theoretical and empirical results show that sharing a small amount of hidden-layer activations significantly improves training efficiency while preserving convergence guarantees and data privacy. Furthermore, we compare our method with existing FL approaches designed to address client drift, including FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedPVR, FedProto, and SplitFed, and demonstrate superior model accuracy under a fixed round budget without incurring excessive communication overhead. Overall, this work presents a promising new knowledge aggregation scheme and provides a comprehensive analysis of the impact of activation sharing on federated optimization.

</details>


### [418] [Does Scaling Reinforcement Learning Really Require More Training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01133)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Hongba Ma,Ruihan Guo,Ge Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了策略空间扩展（policy-space scaling）概念，利用已完成的强化学习（RL）训练历史，通过特征空间融合（SURGE）结合两个检查点（高精度锚点和生成较短响应的捐赠点），无需延长训练或增加推理计算即可获得更强策略。实验在1.5B数学推理（DeepSeek、Nemotron）和7B代码（OLMo）模型上验证，SURGE在基准平均准确率上超越两个输入检查点，且推理token更少，最高达54.17%（AIME24）和83.7%（HumanEval+），超越原生训练曲线最大值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前推理扩展主要依赖增加RL训练计算量或推理时计算量。作者观察到完整的RL训练历史中包含比优化器访问的检查点更强的潜在策略，旨在挖掘存储的RL历史作为可复用的扩展资源，实现不增加训练/推理成本的性能提升。

Method: SURGE（Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion）：从同一RL运行中选取两个检查点——高精度锚点和生成较短响应的竞争性捐赠点。将两者相对共享初始化的权重变化表示为向量，对锚点的更新进行谱分解（特征分解），保留其主导成分并融入捐赠点的互补成分。通过固定保留锚点更新比例的目标，直接从权重确定块大小，无需测试候选策略。

Result: 在两个1.5B数学推理历史（DeepSeek、Nemotron）和一个7B编码历史（OLMo）上评估。SURGE在基准平均准确率上同时超越两个输入检查点，且推理token少于锚点。DeepSeek AIME24达到54.17%（原生最大50.83%），OLMo HumanEval+达到83.7%（原生最大82.8%）。增益超过观测到的训练曲线。几何控制实验证实RL更新结构的重要性，不仅仅是权重位移或token减少。每个构建模型作为单一策略运行。

Conclusion: 存储的RL训练历史是一种可复用的扩展资源：一次训练运行的可用能力不必止步于其最佳检查点。通过策略空间扩展和特征空间融合，可以在不增加计算成本的前提下，从历史检查点中挖掘出更强的推理策略。

Abstract: Scaling reasoning typically spends more compute on reinforcement learning (RL) or on inference. We show that a completed RL training history can yield policies stronger than the checkpoints visited by its optimizer. We call this policy-space scaling: expanding the deployable policy set accessible from a fixed RL history, without extending training or increasing per-query inference computation. We instantiate it with SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion). SURGE combines two checkpoints from the same RL run: a high-accuracy anchor and a competitive donor that generates shorter responses. It expresses both checkpoints as changes from their shared initialization, then spectrally decomposes the anchor's update to retain its dominant component and incorporate the donor's complementary component. With a fixed target for how much of the anchor update to retain, SURGE determines the block size from the weights without testing candidate policies. We evaluate two 1.5B mathematical-reasoning histories, DeepSeek and Nemotron, and one 7B coding history, OLMo. SURGE improves benchmark-average accuracy over both input checkpoints while using fewer reasoning tokens than the anchor. It reaches 54.17% on DeepSeek AIME24 against a measured native maximum of 50.83%, and 83.7% on OLMo HumanEval+ against 82.8%. These gains exceed the observed training curves. Geometric controls support the importance of RL-update structure beyond weight displacement or token reduction alone. Each constructed model runs as a single policy. Our findings identify stored RL history as a reusable scaling resource: the capability available from a training run need not end at its best checkpoint.

</details>


### [419] [Parameter-Efficient Distributionally Robust Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models under Subpopulation Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01143)
*Seonghwi Kim,Sung Ho Jo,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 DR-TFM，一种参数高效的分布鲁棒适配框架，用于解决表格基础模型在子群体分布偏移下的最差组准确率问题，无需真实组别标注，仅微调极少量参数即可显著提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型虽然平均准确率高，但在训练与部署时群体比例发生变化的子群体分布偏移场景下，对欠代表群体表现较差。现有鲁棒方法通常需要真实组别标注，实际应用中难以获取。

Method: DR-TFM 通过微调现有的查询缩放网络或新增并训练一个查询缩放网络，调整模型对标记上下文示例的注意力权重，其余参数保持冻结。框架采用两种鲁棒目标：基于训练数据估计的群体分布和源条件分布。以 TabPFN-3 为例，仅更新 0.016% 的预训练参数。

Result: 在五个表格基准上，DR-TFM 的平均最差组准确率显著优于预训练 TFMs 及对比的无真实组别标注的鲁棒基线，同时保持具有竞争力的平均组准确率。在 ACS Income 数据集及另外四个 TFMs 上也观察到类似改进。

Conclusion: DR-TFM 提供了一种无需真实组别标注、参数极其高效的分布鲁棒适配方案，有效缓解了表格基础模型在子群体分布偏移下的性能下降，具有广泛的适用性和实用价值。

Abstract: Despite strong mean accuracy, tabular foundation models (TFMs) can perform poorly on underrepresented groups under subpopulation shift, where group proportions change between training and deployment. We propose DR-TFM, a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework that requires no true group annotations. DR-TFM adjusts attention to labeled context examples by fine-tuning an existing query scaling network or adding and training one, while keeping all other parameters fixed. We instantiate the framework with two robust objectives using estimated groups or source conditional distributions derived from training data. For TabPFN-3, adaptation updates only 0.016% of the pretrained model's parameters. Across five tabular benchmarks, DR-TFM achieves substantially higher average worst-group accuracy than pretrained TFMs and the compared robust baselines without true group annotations, while maintaining competitive mean group accuracy. DR-TFM also improves average worst-group accuracy on ACS Income and across four additional TFMs.

</details>


### [420] [Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01153)
*Di He,Pengxiang Li,Da Chang,Qingyan Meng,Lu Yin,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LOOM方法，解决循环Transformer在大规模MoE模型中的扩展难题，通过稳定循环状态和多样化专家选择，实现了9-12层循环的稳定扩展，显著降低困惑度并提升零样本准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer通过共享块重复应用增加有效深度而不增参数，但在大规模MoE模型下FLOPs匹配比较中收益不明确：额外迭代的增益快速递减甚至退化，现有工作通常仅用2次循环。主要障碍有二：1) 循环继承并放大了深度诅咒，残差更新累积导致隐藏状态方差增长，破坏深度循环稳定性；2) 专家选择崩塌，路由器跨循环重复选择相同专家，额外计算不增加计算多样性。

Method: 提出LOOM，核心原则：每次循环贡献新计算同时保持循环状态稳定。稳定性措施：缩放残差更新以限制方差增长，每层循环重注入输入嵌入。多样性措施：每循环独立路由器选择不同专家，引入Looping Residual跨循环传递早期输出。

Result: 100M-1.7B模型实验显示稳定扩展至9-12循环。近等FLOPs下，700M模型5循环最优：困惑度18.36→16.54，零样本准确率38.84%→39.53%。不匹配FLOPs下，1.7B模型60B tokens训练，9循环峰值：困惑度9.62→7.77，零样本准确率42.4%→47.7%。

Conclusion: LOOM通过解决深度诅咒和专家选择崩塌两大核心问题，使循环MoE模型实现了深度循环的稳定扩展，在参数量不变情况下显著提升模型性能，为LLM扩展提供了新的有效维度。

Abstract: Looped Transformers introduce recurrent depth as a new scaling axis for LLMs: by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, they increase effective depth without increasing parameter count. However, the benefits of looping remain unclear for large MoE LLMs under FLOPs-matched comparisons. The main reason is that the gains from additional iterations diminish quickly and can even turn into degradation, so the extra FLOPs spent on looping yield little substantial improvement. Consequently, prior work typically settles on two loops. We identify two main obstacles to scaling looped MoE. First, looping inherits and amplifies the curse of depth: hidden-state variance grows with each iteration as residual updates accumulate, which destabilizes deep recurrence and causes representations to drift. Second, looped MoE suffers from expert selection collapse: routers repeatedly select the same experts across loops, so extra iterations add computation without adding computational diversity. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose LOOM, built on a single principle: each loop should contribute new computation while keeping the recurrent state stable. LOOM stabilizes recurrence by scaling residual updates to bound variance growth and re-injecting the input embedding at every loop, and diversifies it through per-loop routers that engage different experts and a Looping Residual that carries earlier outputs forward. Experiments across 100M-1.7B models show stable scaling to 9-12 loops. Under near-iso-FLOP, the 700M model performs best at 5 loops, reducing perplexity from 18.36 to 16.54 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 38.84% to 39.53% over the non-looped baseline. Without FLOP matching, the 1.7B model trained on 60B tokens peaks at 9 loops, reducing perplexity from 9.62 to 7.77 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 42.4% to 47.7%. Code is available https://github.com/hed-ucas/LOOM.

</details>


### [421] [QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01554)
*Ivan Ilin,Peter Richtárik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QK-Wanda 是一种改进的剪枝方法，通过联合考虑 query 和 key 权重的删除成本，减少重构误差并提升下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wanda 独立对每个线性投影中的权重打分剪枝，但 query 和 key 通过点积交互，忽略了这种耦合关系，导致剪枝效果受限。

Method: QK-Wanda 在无掩码的 pre-RoPE 重构目标下，通过闭式解计算 query 和 key 权重的单独删除成本，将来自对侧投影的信息融入 Wanda 分数，使两个投影共享剪枝预算，无需梯度或权重更新。

Result: 在 15 个模型（0.5B-72B）上评估，QK-Wanda 平均降低 QK 重构误差 60%（50% 稀疏度）和 45%（80% 稀疏度）。在 Llama 2 70B 80% 稀疏度下，WikiText-2 和 C4 perplexity 分别下降 20.3% 和 13.5%，零样本准确率提升 5.94 个百分点。Qwen2.5-72B 也有改进，但 Llama-3.1-70B perplexity 显著增加尽管重构误差更低。

Conclusion: 耦合剪枝准则有前景，但局部重构误差不一定能预测模型质量，存在局限性。

Abstract: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B-72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on the model. At 80% sparsity on Llama 2 70B, WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity decrease by 20.3% and 13.5%, while mean zero-shot accuracy rises by 5.94 percentage points. Qwen2.5-72B also improves, but Llama-3.1-70B has substantially higher perplexity despite lower reconstruction error. These results show both the promise of coupled pruning criteria and the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of model quality.

</details>


### [422] [A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01801)
*Sahil Kadadekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文审查了基于安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度作为安全评分的方法（正质心规则），发现该方法在多个数据集和编码器上表现不稳定且往往低于随机水平，而显式的安全-不安全参考方向则显著优于正质心基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期有睡眠代理检测器提出使用已知安全响应的均值嵌入（正质心）的余弦相似度作为安全评分，但该正质心规则未被充分验证：正样本仅定位安全类别相对于编码器原点的位置，并不确定分离安全与不安全响应的方向。

Method: 在两个提示词控制的、人工标注语料库（PKU-SafeRLHF、Aegis）和一个辅助陪审团标签源控制上，使用四个冻结编码器和提示词分组划分，对比正质心原型与显式安全减不安全参考向量的性能；另评估验证校准的5%假安全阈值下的接受率、无标签保留参考与有标签不安全样本数量的影响、以及提示词-only消融实验。

Result: 人工标注语料上正质心ROC-AUC为0.457-0.545（两个显著低于随机、一个高于随机），显式参考向量达0.588-0.738；陪审团控制上正质心反转（0.358-0.405），参考向量达0.754-0.793。5%假安全阈值下，参考向量在PKU-SafeRLHF（0.153-0.263 vs 0.039-0.061）和Aegis（0.189-0.291 vs 0.004-0.045）接受更多安全响应，但在BeaverTails上不稳定。无标签保留参考能恢复大部分参考排序，当不安全比例仅5%时恢复较少；80-634个标注不安全样本能恢复大部分。提示词-only消融显示提示词-标签组合可能虚增未控评估指标。

Conclusion: 类别均值只是位置，不一定是安全方向；含有足够不安全质量的显式参考向量才能确定方向。这是对原始正质心的有界结论，不适用于所有一类方法或安全专用防护模型。

Abstract: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.

</details>


### [423] [Detect, Explain, Interpret: An End-to-End Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Explainability and Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01168)
*Roberto Stanzione,Jules Barbe,Magali Parrino,Jérémie Fourmann,Paul Boniol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SHAD基准，包含215个来自真实分布式云存储系统的多变量高维时间序列，提供丰富语义注释，覆盖三类不同严重程度的异常，旨在解决现有基准缺乏可解释性和可阐释性评估的问题，并对检测、解释性、可阐释性三个阶段的基线方法进行全面评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测器多忽略领域上下文，缺乏可解释性和可阐释性。主要原因在于当前基准主要关注检测准确度，极少评估空间解释性，且没有基准提供足够丰富的语义注释以支持生成人类可理解的异常解释。

Method: 构建SHAD基准：收集215个真实分布式云存储系统的多变量高维时间序列，包含三类不同严重程度的异常家族及丰富上下文信息。评测三阶段基线：1) 检测阶段：对比多种现有异常检测器效果；2) 解释性阶段：评估各维度对异常得分的贡献度测量是否能提供准确异常归因；3) 可阐释性阶段：研究冻结LLM基线在异常定位和解释上的有效性。

Result: 在真实世界数据集上全面评测了现有检测器性能；验证了基于维度贡献度的解释性方法能否准确归因；探索了冻结LLM在异常定位和语义解释上的能力，为TSAD全流程提供了基准评测框架。

Conclusion: SHAD填补了时间序列异常检测领域缺乏具备丰富语义注释、支持可解释性与可阐释性评估的高维真实基准的空白，为未来研究提供了涵盖检测、解释、阐释全流程的统一评测平台。

Abstract: Time Series Anomaly Detection has received increasing attention, driven by the growing availability of complex time series data. This surge has led to the development of numerous detection methods, as well as a variety of benchmarks aimed at thoroughly evaluating their performance. However, most existing detectors remain largely agnostic to domain context, overlooking explainability and interpretability. One of the main reasons for this gap is that current benchmarks primarily focus on detection accuracy, and only few of them evaluate spatial explainability. Moreover, no benchmark currently provides sufficiently rich semantic annotations to support the generation of human-understandable interpretations of anomalies. To address these limitations, we introduce SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection benchmark), a fully annotated benchmark composed of 215 multivariate, high-dimensional time series collected from real-world distributed cloud storage systems operated by Scality. The proposed dataset includes rich contextual information, covering three families of anomalies with varying degrees of severity. As further contribution, we provide a foundation for future work by evaluating baseline methods for Detection, Explainability, and Interpretability, covering all stages of a TSAD pipeline. For Detection, we benchmark a wide range of existing anomaly detectors, testing their effectiveness on the proposed real-world dataset. Then, we consider explainability by evaluating whether measuring the contribution of each dimension in the generated anomaly score can provide accurate anomaly attributions. Finally, for interpretability, we investigate the effectiveness of frozen LLM baselines in localizing and interpreting anomalies.

</details>


### [424] [Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01821)
*Tido Specht,Elias Benedict Krey,Nils Neukirch,Nils Strodthoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将非线性多维概念发现（NLMCD）从计算机视觉迁移到LLM的token级激活，把概念建模为低维流形，并提出基于概念的对齐（CBA）分数来跨层/跨模型比较概念流形。实验揭示了六大核心发现：CBA比线性基线更敏感；中后层呈现两个块状结构；概念组合长期以句法为主、后期转为句法-语义混合且更偏向输出；多语言概念共享取决于训练而非普适；同族模型间对齐强、跨族弱；Tulu-3训练阶段中相邻阶段对齐最高，基模型到SFT变化最大，后续DPO/RLVR对早层影响小、RLVR基本保留DPO的晚层概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性方法多假设概念是线性的，但证据表明特征流形具有非线性结构。需要超越线性概念，用流形建模捕捉LLM内部表示的几何组织，并提供一种不依赖显式特征匹配的跨层/跨模型对齐度量。

Method: 1) 将Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD)应用于token级LLM激活，将概念建模为低维流形。2) 提出Concept-Based Alignment (CBA)分数——广义Rand指数——度量概念流形间的几何邻近性，无需显式特征匹配。3) 在多个模型（GPT-2、Llama、Qwen家族）及Tulu-3训练检查点上逐层计算CBA，并与PCA/CKA等线性基线对比。

Result: 六大发现：(i) 相邻层健检显示CBA比PCA/CKA线性基线更敏感。(ii) 逐层对齐矩阵揭示中层和晚层各有一个块状结构，跨模型一致，线性指标掩盖了此结构。(iii) 概念组合在大部分层以句法为主，后期转为句法-语义混合且输出导向增强。(iv) 英语-普通话概念共享随训练而异：Qwen最强、Llama较弱、GPT-2无共享。(v) 模型间对齐呈现同族强、跨族弱模式。(vi) Tulu-3训练阶段中，相邻阶段对齐最高；基模型→SFT变化最大；DPO/RLVR基本不改变早层，RLVR基本保留DPO的晚层概念。

Conclusion: 非线性流形建模配合CBA度量能更灵敏地揭示LLM内部表示的几何组织：中后层存在稳健的块状概念结构，概念演化呈现从句法到句法-语义混合的渐变，多语言概念共享并非普适而是训练诱导的，模型族谱决定跨模型对齐强弱，后训练阶段主要重塑晚层概念且RLVR在概念层面近似DPO。这为理解LLM信息处理机制提供了超越线性假设的新视角。

Abstract: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. We move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. To compare concept manifolds across layers and models, we introduce a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, a generalized Rand index that measures geometric proximity without explicit feature matching. Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer-by-layer alignment matrices reveal two block structures in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic-semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure, with strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) across Tulu-3 training stages, alignment is highest between adjacent stages, with the largest shift between the base model and SFT, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO's concepts in late layers.

</details>


### [425] [Learning Rate Transfer for Hybrid Transformer-SSM Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01172)
*Jimin Seo,Gyubok Lee,Yeonsik Jo,Kiwoong Yoo,Yeongoon Kim,Minhae Oh,Jin Woo Koo,Suhwan Kim,Nakyung Lee,Minsik Seol,Idris Nechnech,Jaehyeon Kim,Giho Lee,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究混合Transformer-SSM架构的学习率缩放规律，发现尽管SSM操作不满足μP理论的Tensor Programs可表示性条件且通过坐标检查诊断，但在实际固定状态大小的简化ZOH Mamba实现中，使用原始μP处方即可实现跨宽度256-2048、深度4-32、亿参数规模的近零学习率迁移差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理论上，基于零阶保持离散化的无限宽度增长状态大小的SSM缩放规则，与实际生产中采用的固定状态大小简化ZOH Mamba实现存在差距。需要弥合理论缩放规则与混合架构实际实现之间的鸿沟。

Method: 在自定义混合架构集上进行大规模实验：宽度256-2048、深度4-32、高达亿参数规模，测试μP处方下的学习率迁移表现；分析SSM操作对Tensor Programs可表示性条件的违背情况及坐标检查诊断失败原因；将发现验证到生产级混合模型Nemotron-H上。

Result: 混合架构在实用范式下仅用原始μP处方即达成近零LR迁移差距，最优学习率对宽度不变性高达8倍，且跨深度、序列长度、批大小、Transformer-SSM比例均成立，成功迁移至Nemotron-H。归因于双条件分解：全局更新-权重不变性由μP初始化与LR缩放保证；局部逐组件平衡由AdamW逐参数归一化提供。

Conclusion: 实验证实μP处方在混合架构实践中意外有效，揭示了全局不变性与局部平衡的双重机制，填补了理论缩放规则与实际混合实现的鸿沟，为后续研究提供了桥梁方向。

Abstract: We study learning rate (LR) scaling for hybrid architectures combining Transformer and State-Space Model (SSM) blocks, a class adopted by several recent production language models. In particular, we focus on the gap between the theoretical scaling rules derived for SSMs under zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization at infinite width with growing state size, and the field-standard practical implementations using simplified-ZOH Mamba at fixed state size. Surprisingly, in this practical regime hybrid architectures achieve a near-zero LR transfer gap across widths 256-2048 and depths 4-32 up to billion-parameter scale using only the original $μ$P prescription, even though SSM operations fall outside its Tensor Programs representability conditions and every parameterization we test fails the standard coordinate-check diagnostic of $μ$P correctness. We attribute this to a two-condition decomposition of LR transfer in hybrid architectures: a global update-to-weight invariance, enforced by $μ$P's initialization and LR scaling; and a local per-component balance, provided by AdamW's per-parameter normalization. Our observations show that the optimal LR is invariant to width up to 8$\times$, that this width invariance holds across depth, sequence length, batch size, and Transformer-to-SSM ratio, and that it transfers to Nemotron-H, a production hybrid outside our custom architecture set. We hope these findings fill the gap between theoretical scaling rules and practical hybrid implementations, and stimulate further research toward bridging it.

</details>


### [426] [Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01889)
*Yohan Chatelain,Pablo de Oliveira Castro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究低精度Transformer推理中随机舍入(SR)与最近舍入(RN)的选择问题，发现最优舍入方式取决于网络位置。通过开发变精度随机舍入(VPSR)算法和两种理论分析，证明SR在MLP下投影中误差增长为O(√n u)优于RN的O(n u)，且Softmax对MLP的均匀logit偏移不变性使SR方差被折扣；而在语言模型头部，SR引入非均匀方差反而劣于RN。在DistilGPT-2 6位有效数字实验中，混合精度配置(MLP用SR、头部用RN)使困惑度达全精度1.10倍，比统一RN降低28%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低精度Transformer推理中，舍入方式对模型精度影响显著且位置相关，但现有工作缺乏系统性的理论分析和实验验证，无法指导在不同网络位置选择最优舍入策略。

Method: 1. 扩展PRISM库实现变精度随机舍入(VPSR)，在硬件浮点中精确实现任意虚拟精度的舍入决策。2. 建立线性投影的概率前向误差界，分析SR与RN在归约长度n下的误差增长率差异。3. 开发输出Softmax处交叉熵损失变化的二阶分解，包含符号漂移、漂移曲率和Fisher加权方差惩罚，解释不同位置的相反行为。4. 在DistilGPT-2上进行6位有效数字实验验证理论预测。

Result: 理论上：SR在长MLP下投影误差包络为O(√n u)优于RN的O(n u)；Softmax对MLP均匀噪声不变性使SR方差被折扣，而头部非均匀噪声无此优势。实验上：DistilGPT-2在6位精度下，MLP用SR困惑度1.15倍全精度，RN为2.21倍；头部用RN优于SR。混合配置(MLP-SR+头部-RN)困惑度1.10倍全精度，比统一RN降低28%。

Conclusion: 低精度Transformer推理应采用位置感知的混合舍入策略：长归约操作(如MLP下投影)使用SR利用其√n误差缩放和Softmax不变性；输出头部等非均匀噪声敏感位置使用RN避免方差惩罚。该混合精度方案显著优于统一舍入策略，为低精度大模型部署提供理论指导的优化路径。

Abstract: Should low-precision transformer inference use stochastic rounding (SR) or round-to-nearest (RN)? The answer depends on where in the network you look. We isolate this effect by holding the numerical format fixed and varying only the rounding rule at individual operation sites. To enable experiments at freely chosen precisions, we extend the PRISM vectorized rounding library to arbitrary virtual precision via a variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) algorithm, proving that the rounding decision is evaluated exactly in hardware floating point.
  We develop two analyses providing complementary insight into this site-level trade-off. First, a probabilistic forward-error bound for linear projections shows that SR's error envelope grows as $O(\sqrt{n} u)$ in reduction length $n$, versus $O(n u)$ for RN, a gap that widens rapidly at low precision and is most pronounced in the long multilayer perceptron (MLP) down-projection. Second, a second-order decomposition of expected cross-entropy loss change at the output softmax into signed drift, drift curvature, and a Fisher-weighted variance penalty reveals why the two sites behave oppositely: MLP noise is predominantly a uniform logit shift to which softmax is invariant, so SR's variance is largely discounted; head noise is non-uniform across the vocabulary and is not.
  On DistilGPT-2 at $t=6$ significand bits, observations match theory: SR in the MLP raises perplexity to 1.15x the full-precision reference, versus 2.21x for RN. At the language-model head, the ordering reverses because SR introduces non-uniform variance, whereas deterministic RN carries none. In a mixed-precision configuration (MLP output at $t=6$), assigning SR to the MLP and RN to the head brings perplexity within 1.10x of the full-precision reference, a 28% reduction over matched-bit RN.

</details>


### [427] [CAGE-NAS: Certified Functional Descent for Efficient Model Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01173)
*Santiago Florido Gomez,Stéphane Rivaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAGE-NAS 提出了一种基于函数空间的神经网络渐进式增长方法，通过函数梯度下降的可接受性准则决定何时扩展架构，在相同参数预算下实现了超过 99.8 百分位的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经架构搜索方法难以在训练过程中动态决定何时保持当前架构、何时进行扩展，且通常需要枚举大量候选架构，计算成本高昂。需要一种理论化、高效的方法来自动确定架构增长时机。

Method: CAGE-NAS 在函数空间中建立可接受性准则，利用函数梯度的正则化投影（切空间诱导的族）来认证函数梯度下降步骤。当当前表示能通过认证时保持架构不变；认证失败时应用保函数扩展，并重新评估新表示。

Result: 在受控设置下，CAGE-NAS 生成的架构在保留 RMSE 指标上位于所有可接受替代方案的 99.8 百分位以上，且在增长轨迹中无需枚举所有候选架构，实现了高效且高性能的架构搜索。

Conclusion: CAGE-NAS 通过函数空间视角和理论认证机制，解决了神经网络渐进式增长中的关键决策问题，提供了一种无需穷举搜索即可获得近优架构的高效方法。

Abstract: The progressive growth of neural networks requires deciding when the current representation remains sufficient for optimization and when it should be expanded. CAGE-NAS formulates this decision in function space through an admissibility criterion on approximations of the functional gradient. As long as a representation enables a certified Functional Gradient Descent step, the architecture remains fixed; when the criterion fails, a function-preserving expansion is applied and the resulting representation is evaluated again. As the main instance, we study the family induced by the tangent space, using a regularized projection of the functional gradient. In a controlled setting with exact certification, CAGE-NAS produces architectures positioned above the 99.8th performance percentile by held-out RMSE among all admissible alternatives within the same parameter budget, without enumerating them during the growth trajectory.

</details>


### [428] [Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01947)
*Xinjian Zhao,Yaoyao Xu,Xuemin Chen,Xiaozhuang Song,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent JEPA 框架，结合自回归学习与联合嵌入预测，通过潜在思维预测未来化学推理步骤与分子结果，在 ChemCoTBench 上提升分子优化、编辑及反应预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型虽具化学知识与多步推理能力，但缺乏类似化学家直觉的“预期”机制；现有方法需显式生成每一中间步骤，效率低且难捕捉隐性化学规律。

Method: 提出 Latent JEPA：在自回归生成文本推理的同时，引入联合嵌入预测目标，让连续潜在表示预测未来一个或多个视图（文本推理片段、分子结构/性质），通过文本与分子双预测目标对齐潜在思维与化学结果。

Result: 在 ChemCoTBench 基准上，分子优化、编辑、反应预测等指标均有提升；表征分析显示潜在思维对分子结果的信息量增加，与化学结构的对应关系增强。

Conclusion: 抽象的未来预测可作为连接连续潜在推理与科学结果的有效学习原则，为化学推理等科学任务提供新范式。

Abstract: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce Latent JEPA, a framework that combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of one or more future views. For chemical reasoning, we develop textual and molecular prediction objectives that connect latent thoughts to both subsequent reasoning and molecular outcomes. Experiments on ChemCoTBench show gains in molecular optimization and on several editing and reaction metrics. Representation analyses show that future prediction makes latent thoughts more informative about molecular outcomes and strengthens their correspondence with chemical structure. These findings support abstract future prediction as a learning principle for connecting continuous latent reasoning with scientific outcomes.

</details>


### [429] [Rethinking the Information Bottleneck: Structured Decomposition under Label-Induced Partitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01175)
*Jingyao Zhang,Yuxuan Li,Lu Han,Ali Anaissi,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出双瓶颈信息瓶颈方法，通过标准KL项控制全局信息容量，条件KL项针对条件内信息，分离任务相关结构与噪声变化，提升低数据量分类和密集预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准信息瓶颈使用单一标量I(Z;X)隐式地将所有信息视为同质，耦合了标签相关结构与条件内残差变化，无法独立调控，导致噪声信息残留，尤其在医学成像等数据有限场景中加剧过拟合。现有正则化方法虽能稳定训练、控制容量或塑造几何，但未显式分离噪声变化与任务支持结构。

Method: 基于标签诱导的划分，重新审视IB，提出双瓶颈公式：标准KL项控制全局信息容量，条件KL项针对条件内信息。证明条件KL可精确分解为条件内信息项和先验不匹配项，配合单纯形结构的条件先验，实现可控的潜在几何，无缝集成现有流程。

Result: 在分类和分割实验中，低数据量分类增益最明显，在密集预测基准上持续改进。

Conclusion: 双瓶颈IB通过显式分离条件结构和条件内信息，有效抑制噪声变化，提升泛化能力，尤其在数据稀缺场景下表现优异，为表示学习提供了新的正则化视角。

Abstract: Standard information bottleneck (IB) regularization constrains representations via a single scalar I(Z;X), implicitlytreating all information as homogeneous. However, a single global compression control couples label-relevant structurewith residual within-condition variation, rather than regulating their allocation independently, allowing nuisanceinformation to persist in learned representations. For example, in medical imaging applications, residual variation oftenstems from acquisition conditions, background factors, or subject-specific appearance. This issue becomes particularlypronounced in data-limited settings, where models tend to overfit such variation, hindering generalization. While existingregularization methods can stabilize training, control capacity, or shape representation geometry, they do not explicitlyseparate nuisance-like variation from task-supporting structure. To address this limitation, we revisit IB from a structuredperspective based on a label-induced partition, where condition-level structure and within-condition information playdistinct roles. This leads to a dual-bottleneck formulation: a standard KL term controls global information capacity, while aconditional KL term targets within-condition information. We show that the conditional KL admits an exact decompositioninto a within-condition information term and a prior-mismatch term, explaining its alignment with the design objective.With a simplex-structured conditional prior, the method provides controllable latent geometry and integrates seamlesslyinto existing pipelines. Experiments on classification and segmentation show the clearest gains in low-data classificationand consistent improvements across dense prediction benchmarks.

</details>


### [430] [Fully Online Decentralized Learning in Stochastic Games with Unknown Independent Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01181)
*S. Rasoul Etesami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种全在线、去中心化、无需协调的镜像下降算法，用于在未知独立控制链的随机博弈中学习稳态纳什均衡策略。算法在占用测度的对偶空间运行，仅依赖局部信息，无需覆盖联合状态空间或同步回合。在均匀遍历性和有限覆盖假设下，时间平均固定比较器后悔以 O(T^{-1/2}) 速率衰减，复杂度依赖于各玩家局部状态空间的覆盖时间而非乘积状态空间，避免了指数级依赖。该方法还提供近似粗相关均衡保证，并在额外的全局变分稳定性条件下实现最后迭代收敛到稳态 ε-纳什均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在未知转移核且玩家仅能观测局部状态和收益的随机博弈中，如何设计可扩展的全在线学习算法以逼近稳态纳什均衡。现有方法往往需要联合状态空间覆盖或同步回合，导致指数级复杂度；计算稳态 ε-纳什均衡在该设定下是 PPAD-hard 的，因此转而寻求近似粗相关均衡作为更自然的目标。

Method: 开发一种在占用测度对偶空间运行的镜像下降算法，每一步仅使用单个转移/奖励样本，完全在线、去中心化且无需协调。算法利用独立链的局部结构，不需要覆盖联合状态空间或同步回合。理论分析基于均匀遍历性和有限覆盖假设，建立时间平均固定比较器后悔界；在额外全局变分稳定性条件下分析最后迭代收敛性。

Result: 在均匀遍历性和有限覆盖假设下，高概率下时间平均固定比较器后悔以 O(T^{-1/2}) 速率衰减（含对数因子和多项式参数依赖），复杂度仅依赖各玩家局部状态空间的覆盖时间，避免了玩家数量和联合状态/动作空间大小的指数依赖。有限时间后悔界提供近似粗相关均衡保证。在额外的全局变分稳定性条件下，同一算法在最后迭代渐近收敛到稳态 ε-纳什均衡。

Conclusion: 提出的全在线镜像下降算法为具有未知独立链的随机博弈提供了可扩展的学习框架，兼具去中心化、无需协调、仅依赖局部信息的优势。算法可视为利用独立链局部结构的原始-对偶框架，实现了后悔最小化和均衡学习的统一，解决了大规模随机博弈中的指数复杂度难题。

Abstract: We consider stochastic games with independent controlled chains and unknown transition kernels, where players observe only their local states and realized payoffs. We develop a fully online, decentralized, and uncoordinated mirror-descent algorithm that operates in the dual space of occupancy measures for approximating stationary Nash equilibrium (NE) policies. The algorithm uses a single transition/reward sample at every primitive time step, relies only on local information, and requires neither coverage of the joint state space nor synchronized episodes. Under uniform-ergodicity and finite-coverage assumptions, we show that, with high probability, the time-averaged fixed-comparator regret decays at the canonical $O(T^{-1/2})$ rate, up to logarithmic factors and polynomial dependence on the game parameters. In particular, the complexity depends on the cover times of the individual local state spaces rather than the product state space, avoiding exponential dependence on the number of players and the sizes of the joint state and action spaces. The resulting finite-time regret bound further yields an approximate coarse-correlated-equilibrium guarantee, which is natural for arbitrary reward functions since computing a stationary $ε$-NE is PPAD-hard in this setting. Under an additional global variational-stability condition, we show that the same fully online algorithm converges asymptotically in the last iterate to a stationary $ε$-NE. Our results provide a fully online and scalable learning framework for stochastic games with unknown independent chains. The algorithm can also be viewed as a primal-dual framework for Markov games that exploits the independence and local structure of the players' controlled transition chains.

</details>


### [431] [Counterfactual Generation via Flow Matching: Coupling-Sensitive End-to-End Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01193)
*Yunrui Guan,Krishnakumar Balasubramanian,Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于流匹配的反事实生成方法，结合双重鲁棒训练目标与学习到的源-目标耦合，并引入基于高斯平滑插值的分数校正随机采样器。理论上建立了耦合敏感的KL散度界，误差由源-目标位移矩控制而非速度场全局正则性，且对环境维度呈近线性依赖；同时给出了端到端的有限样本非参数保证。实验验证了理论，并在有限离散化预算下随机采样器优于确定性ODE采样器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实生成旨在利用观测数据在假设干预下采样结果。现有方法在有限步生成、理论保证（特别是耦合依赖的误差界）以及非参数估计误差分解方面存在不足。需要一种能结合双重鲁棒性、学习耦合、并提供耦合敏感理论保证的流匹配框架。

Method: 1. 流匹配框架：采用样本分割的双重鲁棒训练目标。2. 学习源观测结果与目标条件结果模型结果之间的耦合。3. 基于高斯平滑插值的分数校正随机采样器，实现有限步生成。4. 理论分析：耦合敏感的KL界（常数步欧拉离散化），误差由耦合下的位移矩控制；有限样本非参数保证，分解近似、耦合替换、干扰估计、泛化和蒙特卡洛误差。

Result: 理论上：建立了耦合敏感的KL散度界，误差依赖于源-目标位移矩而非速度场全局正则性，对维度呈近线性依赖；给出了端到端有限样本保证，分解了五类误差源。实验上：在合成和半合成图像基准上验证了耦合依赖理论；在有限离散化预算下，随机采样器优于确定性ODE采样器。

Conclusion: 该工作为反事实生成提供了一个理论扎实且实用的流匹配框架。耦合敏感的分析揭示了耦合质量对离散化误差的关键作用，随机采样器在有限步预算下表现更优。误差分解为实际应用中的模型选择和诊断提供了指导。

Abstract: Counterfactual generation seeks to sample outcomes under a hypothetical intervention or decision using observational data collected under the factual assignment mechanism. We develop a flow-matching approach that combines a sample-split, doubly robust training objective with a learned coupling between observed source outcomes and target outcomes drawn from a fitted conditional outcome model. To enable finite-step generation, we leverage a score-corrected stochastic sampler based on a Gaussian-smoothed interpolation. Our main theoretical contribution is a coupling-sensitive KL bound for constant-step Euler discretization: the error is controlled by moments of the source--target displacement under the chosen coupling, rather than by global uniform regularity of the velocity field, and has near-linear dependence on the ambient dimension. We also establish finite-sample non-parametric guarantees for the learned velocity and score fields when both the conditional outcome model and the source-target coupling are estimated from data. These bounds separate approximation, coupling-replacement, nuisance-estimation, generalization, and Monte Carlo errors and, combined with the sampler analysis, yield an end-to-end guarantee for counterfactual generation. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic image benchmarks support the coupling-dependent theory and show that, at finite discretization budgets, the stochastic sampler can outperform the corresponding deterministic ODE sampler.

</details>


### [432] [CARM: Cancellation-Aware Response Masking for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02039)
*Yafei Zhang,Songshuo Lu,Sicong Liao,Zhi Chen,Yaohua Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CARM（Cancellation-Aware Response Masking），一种序列级掩码方法，通过取token对数比的绝对值再平均，解决几何平均掩码中符号抵消问题，有效控制离策略偏移，在数学推理和代码生成任务上显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM后训练中使用RL时，策略更新和rollout与训练引擎差异导致采样响应变为离策略。现有序列级掩码使用长度归一化的几何平均token概率比，但其符号对数比在不同位置可能相互抵消，掩盖了双向策略漂移，需要一种能感知抵消现象的掩码方法。

Method: 提出Cancellation-Aware Response Masking (CARM)，在计算序列级掩码前，对每个token的对数概率比取绝对值，再取平均，防止相反方向的概率变化相互抵消。理论上证明被接受的响应满足关于采样token比率超出规定范围的比例及其平均对数距离的联合界。

Result: 在数学推理基准（AIME 2024/2025/2026和BeyondAIME）上，CARM较几何平均掩码将mean@16提升高达3.13个百分点；在四个代码基准上，平均pass@1比最强基线提升2.88点。

Conclusion: CARM是一种理论基础扎实且有效的响应级离策略控制方法，适用于LLM强化学习后训练。

Abstract: Recent years have witnessed the rapid adoption of reinforcement learning (RL) in large language model (LLM) post-training, with substantial gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation. In practical systems, however, policy updates and differences between rollout and training engines can make sampled responses off-policy. Sequence-level masking addresses this mismatch by deciding whether an entire response should contribute to optimization. A common masking rule uses the length-normalized geometric mean of sampled token probability ratios. Its signed log-ratios can cancel across positions, concealing substantial bidirectional policy drift. We propose \emph{Cancellation-Aware Response Masking} (CARM), a sequence-level mask that takes the absolute value of each token log-ratio before averaging, preventing opposing probability changes from canceling. We prove that accepted responses satisfy a joint bound on the fraction of sampled-token ratios outside a prescribed band and their mean log-distance beyond its boundaries. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that CARM improves mean@16 averaged over AIME 2024/2025/2026 and BeyondAIME by up to $3.13$ percentage points over geometric-mean masking, and increases average pass@1 across four code benchmarks by $2.88$ points over the strongest evaluated baseline. These findings support CARM as a theoretically grounded and effective method for response-level off-policy control in LLM reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [433] [Low-Budget Active Learning through Entropic Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01199)
*Rim Hajal,Mathieu Besançon,Jérôme Malick*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于熵正则最优传输（Sinkhorn散度）的低预算主动学习核心集选择方法，利用自监督预训练模型的特征表示，在特征空间中直接进行核心集选择，实现了无维度样本复杂度保证和高效的梯度计算，结合梯度优化与交换局部搜显著优于现有启发式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在标注成本极高的场景（如医学影像）中，需要从海量无标签数据中选取极少量样本进行标注，以低预算训练高精度模型。现有核心集选择方法多依赖启发式策略，缺乏理论保证且在高维特征空间效果有限。

Method: 1. 使用自监督预训练模型提取数据特征；2. 在特征空间中以Sinkhorn散度作为核心集选择准则，该准则提供无维度样本复杂度界且梯度计算高效；3. 采用基于梯度的算法快速生成候选解，再通过基于交换的局部搜索进一步优化，并提供解质量保证。

Result: 在多个图像基准数据集和医学数据集上，该方法在极低标注预算下持续超越现有最先进的启发式核心集选择方法，验证了理论优势在实际中的有效性。

Conclusion: 引入熵正则最优传输作为核心集选择目标，结合自监督特征表示、梯度优化与局部搜索，为低预算主动学习提供了一个理论扎实且实用高效的解决方案，特别适合标注昂贵的专业领域应用。

Abstract: We consider low-budget active learning, which consists of selecting a limited number of points, the coreset, such that a model can be trained to high accuracy on the selection only. This problem is particularly relevant in contexts where labeling requires costly expert intervention, as in medical applications. We leverage features extracted from a pretrained self-supervised model to represent the data, and perform coreset selection directly in this feature space. In this paper, we use entropic optimal transport, specifically the Sinkhorn divergence, as the coreset selection criterion, which first allows us to get dimension-free sample complexity results, and second admits computationally efficient gradient evaluations. This opens the way to using gradient-based algorithms to rapidly compute solution candidates, further improved by a swap-based local search, with guarantees on the solution quality. Experiments on image benchmarks and medical datasets show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art heuristics in low-budget settings.

</details>


### [434] [Autoregressive Drillhole Modelling Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01204)
*Yihao Ding,Daniel Yitian Su,Yiran Zhang,Christopher M. Gonzalez,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DrillBench 基准，包含 49,671 个西澳钻孔，用于评估自回归建模在矿产勘探钻孔中的下一层预测与地层生成能力。研究发现空间/地球化学条件在局部有效但泛化差，而岩性序列自回归模型迁移更稳健。提出结合大规模预训练与空间检索的骨干无关方法，在保持局部性能的同时显著提升跨空间和跨地质省的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矿产勘探钻孔天然提供从浅到深的顺序岩性揭示，符合自回归建模范式，但现有研究多基于空间插值、重建或掩码建模，严格自回归预测尚未充分探索。缺乏系统基准评估不同模型在本地、空间偁移至跨地质省迁移谱系上的表现。

Method: 构建 DrillBench 基准，涵盖本地预测、空间偁移、跨地质省迁移三个难度级别。对比经典、地统计、神经网络模型。基于发现的“迁移边界”，设计骨干无关的组合策略：大规模历史钻孔预训练 + 邻近岩性空间检索。检索在风化覆盖层最有效，预训练在基岩及更大地质偁移下贡献更大。

Result: 空间和地球化学条件带来显著局部增益，但在更强偁移下急剧下降；岩性序列自回归模型迁移更稳健。提出的组合方法在保持强局部性能的同时，显著提升空间偁移和跨省偁移下的泛化，尤其在最远分割上改进最明显。

Conclusion: 自回归建模适合钻孔岩性序列预测。DrillBench 为该任务提供首个系统基准。结合预训练与检索的策略有效平衡局部性能与跨域泛化，为矿产勘探中的深部地层预测提供实用范式。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Autoregressive modelling has achieved remarkable success in language and sequence tasks by learning to predict future states from previous observation. Mineral-exploration drillholes provide a natural but largely unexplored setting for this paradigm: as drilling proceeds, lithology is revealed sequentially from shallow to deep, making prediction of deeper strata inherently autoregressive. Existing drillhole modelling, however, is dominated by spatial interpolation and reconstruction, or largely rely on masked modelling, leaving strictly autoregressive prediction largely underexplored. We introduce DrillBench, a benchmark of 49,671 Western Australian drillholes for next-layer prediction and autoregressive stratigraphic generation across a graded transfer spectrum, from local prediction through spatial shift to cross geological province transfer. Benchmarking classical, geostatistical, and neural models reveals a clear \emph{transfer boundary}: spatial and geochemical conditioning provides large local gains but deteriorates sharply under stronger shift, whereas lithology-sequence autoregressive models transfer more robustly. Guided by this finding, we develop a backbone-agnostic recipe combining large-scale pretraining on historical drillholes with spatial retrieval of neighbouring lithology. Retrieval is most effective in weathered cover, when local spatial continuity remains informative, whereas pretraining contributes more strongly in bedrock and under broader geological shift. Together, they retain strong local performance while improving generalisation under spatial and cross-province shift, most markedly on the most distant splits. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/yihaoding/drillbench.

</details>


### [435] [Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02140)
*Aayush Karan,Sitan Chen,Yilun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的采样算法，将离策略专家轨迹逐步转化为更贴近目标模型的在策略数据，使得监督微调（SFT）能达到甚至超越强化学习（RL）的泛化性能，同时减轻灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练范式中，RL 虽泛化强且不易遗忘，但依赖模型自行探索成功轨迹；SFT 可直接利用离策略专家数据，却面临泛化弱、灾难性遗忘问题。作者希望结合两者优势：保留离策略数据的特权信息，又使其更适配学习器的在策略分布，从而提升 SFT 的泛化与鲁棒性。

Method: 设计一种 MCMC 采样算法，以参考模型为锚点，迭代地将离策略专家轨迹“推”向在策略分布。具体而言，算法在轨迹空间构建马尔可夫链，通过接受-拒绝步骤逐步修正数据分布，使其更贴近目标模型的策略，再将转化后的数据用于 SFT。该采样器作为模型原生算子，可插入后训练流水线的各阶段。

Result: 在科学技能习得、数学推理、开放式专业任务等多个基准上，经 MCMC 转化的数据训练出的 SFT 模型，泛化性能媲美甚至优于强在策略 RL 基线，且灾难性遗忘显著降低。微调模型展现出强分布性能，并能超越单纯锐化基模型分布的学习上限。

Conclusion: 将采样视为面向可学习性的数据重塑算子，而非修改学习目标，是一种通用的后训练基元。该工作证明：通过分布层面的在策略化转换，SFT 可兼得离策略数据效率与在策略泛化优势，为后训练栈提供了新的设计范式。

Abstract: Introducing new capabilities to frontier models has long been the goal of posttraining, which predominantly employs supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to this end. Conventional wisdom dictates that RL enables strong generalization on new tasks without losing existing capabilities, while SFT is prone to weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting. At the same time, SFT can learn from off-policy expert data, whereas RL must rely on a model's ability to find successful trajectories with repeated sampling. In our work, we seek to leverage the strength of on-policy learning while utilizing the privileged information contained in off-policy data. However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. We introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy traces to be more on-policy given a reference model for finetuning. Across tasks like scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise, our sampling algorithm enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy baselines. In addition, the resulting finetuned models exhibit strong distributional performance and are capable of learning beyond sharpening the base model distribution. At a higher level, our approach presents sampling as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability, offering broader utility as a general-purpose primitive throughout the posttraining stack.

</details>


### [436] [Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01223)
*David Berghaus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）自主搜索时间序列异常检测程序，无需训练神经网络、无需GPU，在TSB-AD基准上超越现有最强基线，实现了高精度、高效率和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测在预测准确性、计算效率和可解释性之间存在权衡。现有经典、深度学习和基础模型方法难以同时满足这三点。作者希望利用LLM作为程序作者，自动发现紧凑、高效、可解释的检测器。

Method: 构建自主研究循环：LLM反复编辑一个短小的NumPy程序，在无泄露目标下优化，保留得分最高的检测器。循环发现了两个紧凑检测器（单变量和多变量），基于局部频谱特征描述短窗口，通过协方差感知距离与训练区域分布比较。

Result: 在TSB-AD基准上，这两个检测器在多项指标上领先，超越最强经典、深度和基础模型基线（包括Time-RCD），且无需训练网络、无需GPU，多变量检测器比同性能基线更快。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的程序搜索是通往准确、高效、透明异常检测器的实用路径。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. LLM-driven program search is thus a practical route to accurate, efficient, and transparent detectors.

</details>


### [437] [Every Ablation Is a Dose: Counterweights and the Semblance of Self-Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02173)
*Areeb Ahmad,Pratinav Seth,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出仿射定律（E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ）统一解释语言模型中的“自我修复”现象，实验表明该定律在多模型、多任务中广泛成立，揭示自我修复实为预存反向权重的常规运作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对先前研究认为自我修复现象噪声大、缺乏单一解释的观点，本文旨在提供一个统一的机制性解释：即模型内部预先存在增益（gain），干预仅是激活了这一固有的补偿机制。

Method: 将因果干预形式化为反事实对比强度轴λ上的点，提出细粒度单元的因果修复响应遵循仿射定律。在事实裁决任务上跨四个模型家族（Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral）测试MLP神经元、OV神经元及奇异方向；在GPT-2 Small的IOI电路中测试注意力头，并从固定权重预测γ_r大小。

Result: 事实裁决任务中81个下游方向有68个遵循仿射定律，γ_r符号决定单元是抵消还是增强被移除信号，且γ_r大小可从固定权重预测。IOI电路中可达的10个注意力头有7个遵循定律，且全部为反向权重（counterweights）。

Conclusion: 自我修复并非动态涌现的补偿，而是模型内部预存的反向权重在核心位置出现对比信号时执行其常规计算。这为理解模型鲁棒性及干预效应提供了统一的数学框架。

Abstract: Ablate a component of a language model, and other components often appear to adjust and compensate. This phenomenon, termed self-repair, has been observed repeatedly, but its mechanism remains unclear. The most systematic study to date concluded that self-repair is noisy and unlikely to have a single explanation. We argue that it has one: a gain already present before any ablation. Any intervention on a causally important component can be viewed as a point on a coordinate axis $λ$, the signed strength of a counterfactual contrast. Hence, conventional ablation methods are uncalibrated points on this axis. We show that the causal repair response for a fine-grained unit $r$ is governed by an affine law, $E_r(λ)=\mathrm{own}_r+γ_rλ$. The slope $γ_r$ is a fixed coefficient that consistently influences the model, with or without ablation, and its sign determines whether the unit counteracts or reinforces the removed signal. On a factual-verdict task across four models from distinct families (Gemma, Qwen, LLaMA, and Mistral), we identify components including MLP neurons, OV neurons, and singular directions that follow this affine law, 68 of 81 downstream directions in all. Moreover, we can anticipate the magnitude of $γ_r$ from the fixed weights. On the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small, seven of the ten heads the intervention can reach follow the law, and all seven are counterweights. From this perspective, what may appear as self-repair is a counterweight performing its usual operation when the contrastive signal emerges at the core.

</details>


### [438] [Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01224)
*Takumi Hara,Kanata Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出现有潜在世界模型在潜在状态中对末端执行器位置的编码误差大于任务成功判据允许的范围，导致无法区分成功与失败的动作序列。提出一种辅助损失，将成功判据量作为训练目标直接回归，训练后丢弃回归头，不增加测试时开销。在PushT和立方体任务上分别将成功率绝对提升3.5%和3.4%，且显著。成功判据可直接指导潜在状态保留关键物理量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型通过潜在空间距离评分候选动作序列，但任务成功由物理量（成功判据量）判断。现有四种潜在世界模型中，末端执行器位置在潜在状态中的编码误差超过成功判据容许范围，导致潜在状态无法分离成功与失败的候选序列。

Method: 提出辅助损失：在编码器和预测器上接线性回归头，以成功判据量为训练目标进行回归，将回归误差加入训练损失。训练完成后丢弃回归头，测试时模型结构、计算开销和输入均保持不变。

Result: 仅该辅助损失即使PushT任务成功率绝对提升3.5%，立方体任务提升3.4%，两者均具统计学显著性。

Conclusion: 成功判据明确了世界模型潜在状态必须保留的信息，且可直接作为训练目标，无需修改模型架构或增加推理成本。

Abstract: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.

</details>


### [439] [Mixture-Trained Merging for Unified Multi-Objective Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01238)
*SeongHyeon Kim,Chaeyun Jang,Seungyoo Lee,Jiyeon Ham,Yunju Bak,Boseop Kim,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM)，通过在合并前让各分支在目标偏向的数据混合上训练，而非单一目标，使分支在参数空间几何上兼容，解决了朴素权重合并导致的能力退化与思维模式坍塌问题，并利用 qNEHVI 贝叶斯优化高效搜索合并系数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一语言模型需在单一参数集中融合数学、代码、指令跟随及可控思考等异构能力。顺序后训练对超参极其敏感；朴素权重空间合并单目标专家会导致领域能力急剧下降或思考/非思考模式坍塌，根因在于单目标训练使专家漂移到参数空间遥远区域，其插值落出共享低损失盆地。

Method: MTM 让每个分支在目标偏向的数据混合（而非单一目标）上训练，引入跨目标交互使分支几何兼容。采用迭代流程：每轮用全局选定的合并系数提升基座模型，再在保持其它目标约束下用领域偏好系数细化各分支混合。为突破单纯网格搜索，引入 qNEHVI 多目标贝叶斯优化高效搜索系数。

Result: 在代码、数学、指令跟随及思考/非思考控制四大任务上，MTM 显著优于朴素合并，且在单目标合并导致模式坍塌的场景下依然保持行为分离，验证了‘可合并训练’对构建有效统一模型的必要性。

Conclusion: 有效的统一模型需要分支在训练阶段就具备可合并性。MTM 通过混合目标训练与多目标贝叶斯优化，实现了参数空间几何的兼容，为模块化、可扩展的多能力融合提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Unified language models are increasingly expected to combine heterogeneous capabilities, such as mathematics, code, instruction following, and controllable thinking behavior, within a single set of parameters. A common solution is sequential post-training on multiple objectives, but this entangles all objectives along one optimization trajectory and makes the final model highly sensitive to training order, data ratios, schedules, and stopping criteria. Weight-space merging offers a modular alternative, but naive merging of single-objective experts often fails: domain capabilities degrade sharply, or think/non-think modes collapse into one dominant behavior. We attribute both failures to incompatible weight-space geometry: experts trained on single objectives drift to distant regions of parameter space, placing their interpolations outside any shared low-loss basin. We propose Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM), which trains each branch on an objective-biased data mixture rather than a single objective, exposing it to cross-objective interactions and making branches compatible at merge time. MTM uses merged-model evaluations as a low-cost signal for selecting branch mixtures, avoiding expensive data-mixture ablations. The procedure is iterative: each round promotes the base model using globally selected merge coefficients and refines each branch mixture using domain-preferred coefficients under constraints that preserve other objectives. To scale beyond simplex grid search, MTM uses qNEHVI-based multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Across code, mathematics, instruction following, and think/non-think control, MTM outperforms naive merging and preserves behavioral separation where single-objective merging collapses, suggesting that effective unified models require branches trained to be mergeable.

</details>


### [440] [Context-Aware Error Mitigation Orchestration for Hybrid Quantum Reinforcement Learning on NISQ Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01253)
*Bisma Majid,Shabir Ahmed Sofi,Mir Mohammad Yousuf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应策略引导错误缓解（APGEM），一种上下文感知的编排层，可在量子强化学习（QRL）训练期间动态选择最佳错误缓解策略，显著提升 NISQ 设备上的鲁棒性与可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有错误缓解技术多为静态固定校正，无法适应 NISQ 设备上随时间变化的噪声条件及 QRL 训练过程中不断演化的量子态，导致策略质量下降、学习不可靠。

Method: APGEM 在混合量子-经典训练循环中引入上下文感知编排层，利用量子态保真度、策略熵、累积奖励、近似比等策略级指标，动态评估并选择零噪声外推（ZNE）、概率错误消除（PEC）、Clifford 数据回归（CDR）、读出错误缓解（REM）四种缓解策略中最适配的一项，并将其直接集成到强化学习循环中。

Result: 在电容车辆路径问题（CVRP）及多种 NISQ 噪声模型/强度下实验表明：APGEM 持续优于静态缓解方法，达到约 94% 的神策略效用，在噪声增强时仍能维持更高的量子态保真度，并产生更稳定的学习行为；消融实验证实其能学习到适应不同噪声环境和电路执行条件的上下文感知缓解策略。

Conclusion: 将自适应错误缓解集成到学习过程中，能大幅增强 QRL 在 NISQ 硬件上的鲁棒性与可靠性，为大规模组合优化问题的量子近期应用提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) integrates reinforcement learning with parameterized quantum circuits and is a promising approach to combinatorial optimization. On Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices, however, decoherence, gate imperfections, and measurement errors reduce policy quality and make learning less reliable. Existing error mitigation techniques are generally applied as fixed corrections that do not adapt to changing noise conditions or to the evolving state of training. This work presents Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM) as a context-aware orchestration layer of the hybrid quantum-classical training loop that dynamically selects the most suitable mitigation strategy during QRL training. APGEM evaluates Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) using policy-level indicators, including quantum-state fidelity, policy entropy, cumulative reward, and approximation ratio, and integrates the selected strategy directly into the reinforcement learning loop. The framework is evaluated on the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), a representative NP-hard problem in urban logistics, under a range of NISQ noise models and noise levels. APGEM consistently outperforms conventional static mitigation methods, reaches approximately 94% of the utility of an oracle strategy, maintains higher quantum-state fidelity as noise increases, and produces more stable learning behaviour throughout training. Ablation studies show that the framework learns context-aware mitigation policies that adapt to different noise environments and circuit execution conditions. These findings demonstrate that integrating adaptive error mitigation into the learning process substantially improves the robustness and reliability of QRL on NISQ hardware.

</details>


### [441] [IQS-BO: In-Context Query Selection for Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01269)
*Luca Geminiani,Nadja Klein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出IQS-BO，一种基于Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs)的贝叶斯优化方法，通过在合成先验上进行监督学习来直接预测候选点成为全局最优解的概率，实现了完全上下文内的BO或仅摊销决策步骤，显著降低查询成本并在合成与真实基准上匹配或超越标准GP-BO及现有上下文方法。同时提出混合先验预训练策略，结合GP样本与扭曲输入、窄峰最优、平台期等非平稳核难建模的函数，进一步提升优化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化（BO）需在每步重新拟合代理模型并数值最大化采集函数，计算开销大。现有上下文方法如PFNs4BO仅摊销代理模型仍依赖采集函数最大化；FIBO虽完全上下文但固定决策规则且无代理模型；学习型采集函数缺乏查询标签，需用强化学习训练。因此需要一种能直接监督学习查询决策、单次前向传播给出候选点最优概率、灵活支持有/无代理模型且计算高效的方法。

Method: IQS-BO采用Transformer架构，在合成先验上预训练：输入为候选点集合及其历史观测，输出每个候选点为全局最优解的概率分布。损失函数设计使其最小化目标等价于该事件的后验概率。两种使用模式：1) 完全上下文BO，无代理模型；2) 接收固定概率代理（如GP）的预测分布作为额外输入，仅摊销决策步骤。预训练使用混合先验：结合标准GP采样函数与输入扭曲、孤立窄峰最优、平台期等非平稳核难捕捉的函数族。

Result: 在合成函数基准和真实世界任务（如超参数优化、机器人控制、分子设计）上，IQS-BO查询成本仅为采集函数方法的极小分数，性能匹配或超越标准GP-BO、PFNs4BO、FIBO等基线。混合先验预训练相比纯GP先验进一步提升优化效率，尤其在非平稳目标函数上表现优势明显。消融实验验证了监督学习目标、混合先验组件及代理模型融合方式的有效性。

Conclusion: IQS-BO通过监督学习直接建模查询决策，实现了低成本、高性能的贝叶斯优化，统一了完全上下文与代理辅助两种范式。混合先验设计有效解决了平稳核假设的局限性，为PFNs在复杂黑盒优化中的应用提供了更鲁棒的预训练基础。该工作为摊销BO决策过程开辟了新的监督学习路径。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimisation (BO) is a powerful framework for the optimisation of expensive black-box functions, but typically requires refitting a surrogate and maximising an acquisition function at every evaluation step. In-context approaches based on Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) amortise part of this cost by pre-training transformers on functions drawn from synthetic priors. PFNs4BO amortises the surrogate but still relies on a numerically maximised acquisition function, while FIBO performs BO fully in-context by sampling optimiser locations from a learned density, which fixes the decision rule and admits no surrogate. Learned acquisition functions score a finite candidate set with a trained network, but, lacking a label for the query, learn the score by reinforcement learning on previously solved tasks. We propose IQS-BO, a PFN that learns the query decision by supervised learning on synthetic priors. In a single forward pass, IQS-BO predicts the probability that each candidate maximises the objective over the set, and we show that the minimiser of its objective is the posterior probability of this event. The model can be pre-trained without a surrogate for fully in-context BO, or take the predictions of a fixed probabilistic surrogate as additional input, amortising only the decision step. Our method proposes queries at a fraction of the cost of acquisition-based methods, while either matching or outperforming standard BO with Gaussian processes (GPs) and available in-context methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Finally, we propose a mixture prior for pre-training PFNs which combines samples from GPs with functions exhibiting warped inputs, isolated narrow optima, or plateaus that are poorly modeled by stationary kernels common in GP surrogates. We show that pre-training on this prior can lead to improved optimisation performance.

</details>


### [442] [Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01284)
*Mehmet Baygin,Sengul Dogan,Turker Tuncer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本教程系统回顾了机器学习模型验证的多种方案（留出验证、交叉验证、嵌套分组交叉验证等），并结合 EEG、OCT、多中心临床数据等医学场景，通过八个受控实验对比有泄漏与无泄漏的验证设计，分析偏差、方差、指标聚合、不确定性及计算成本，提供决策树、报告清单及可复现代码模板，核心结论是：不存在通用最优验证方法，独立单元须与部署目标匹配，所有依赖数据的操作必须排除用于性能估计的观测值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决模型验证中因划分不当导致的乐观偏差与泄漏问题，针对医学数据的依赖结构（如重复测量、多中心、配对图像）提供系统性的验证方法选择指南，填补通用机器学习验证原则向特定医学数据场景落地的空白。

Method: 综述留出验证、训练/验证/测试划分、重复随机子采样、k折与重复分层交叉验证、留一法/留p法、分组感知验证、嵌套分组交叉验证等方法；设计八个受控场景（全局特征选择泄漏、归一化泄漏、依赖记录、中心混合、重复测试集使用、估计器不稳定等），采用锁定混淆矩阵与可审计指标、可复现重复实验模拟对比有缺陷与防泄漏设计；分析偏差、方差、指标聚合、不确定性、计算成本；提供数据规模矩阵、决策树、报告清单及 MATLAB/scikit-learn 可复现模板。

Result: 实验表明：防泄漏设计能显著降低乐观偏差；验证方法的偏差-方差权衡随数据规模、依赖结构、任务类型变化；嵌套分组交叉验证在多中心/依赖数据中表现最稳健，但计算成本最高；无单一方法在所有场景最优。

Conclusion: 模型验证必须根据部署目标确定独立单元，所有依赖数据的预处理、特征选择、超参数调优均需在验证循环内部进行，严禁测试集信息泄漏；提供的决策树与清单可指导实践者选择合适验证方案并规范报告。

Abstract: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computational cost are also examined. A data-size matrix, a decision tree, and reporting checklists are provided. Reproducible MATLAB templates and scikit-learn counterparts are included. The results show that no validation method is universally best. The independent unit must match the intended deployment target. Every data-dependent operation must also exclude the observations used for performance estimation.

</details>


### [443] [EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01315)
*Qiuliang Liu,Liming Wu,Qi Li,Zhonglong Peng,Chang Chen,Xiaolong Chen,Wenbing Huang,Shifeng Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种用于无序晶体结构预测的生成模型 EP-Flow，基于占用分布矩阵 (ODM) 和熵正则化流匹配，在化学式条件下实现了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型主要针对有序晶体，但许多功能材料本质上是无序的（置换混合、空位、间隙原子），且缺乏位点级无序标注，需要仅从化学式预测无序结构。

Method: 构建占用分布矩阵 (ODM) 表示无序晶体，满足位点占用、质量守恒、非负性约束，形成运输多面体。提出 Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow)：将异构多面体规范化到共享双中心空间，学习保边际流，通过 Sinkhorn 逆映射恢复可行占用，联合生成占用、分数坐标和晶格参数。

Result: 在来自 COD 和 MPDS 的化学式条件无序 CSP 基准上达到最先进性能，显著优于改编的有序晶体生成器；且能恢复稀疏且化学意义明确的局部无序模式，而非仅匹配全局组成统计。

Conclusion: EP-Flow 通过 ODM 和熵正则化流匹配，有效解决了仅从化学式预测无序晶体结构的问题，实现了高保真的无序结构生成，为功能材料设计提供了新工具。

Abstract: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.

</details>


### [444] [Prediction-powered Neural Architecture Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01317)
*Pascal Janetzky,Yuxin Wang,Michael Klar,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PPNAS提出一种预测驱动推断(PPI)方法，融合少量真实性能标签与大量零成本代理(ZCP)信息，利用ZCP序数信息构建成对排序监督并校正系统偏差，在有限评估预算下实现最先进的预测器NAS性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAS面临固有权衡：真实性能标签获取昂贵且稀缺，而零成本代理(ZCP)计算廉价但噪声大。如何有效融合这两种监督源以实现标签高效的架构搜索仍是开放问题。

Method: PPNAS融合两种监督源：(1)少量带真实性能标签的架构；(2)大量带ZCP信息的架构。利用ZCP的序数信息构建成对排序监督，引入预测驱动推断(PPI)框架校正ZCP排序与真实性能排序间的系统偏差，实现无偏性能预测器训练。

Result: 在端到端预测器NAS任务中，PPNAS在有限评估预算下达到最先进性能。据作者所知，这是首个用于标签高效NAS的预测驱动方法。

Conclusion: PPNAS通过PPI框架有效融合稀疏真实标签与嘈杂ZCP信息，解决了NAS中的标签稀缺问题，为低成本神经架构搜索提供了新范式。

Abstract: Evaluating candidate architectures in neural architecture search (NAS) faces an inherent trade-off: on the one hand, reliable performance labels are limited because training and evaluating architectures is costly; on the other hand, zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) are cheap to compute at large scale but can be noisy. Yet, how to effectively combine these two sources of supervision remains unclear. In this paper, we propose PPNAS, a novel prediction-powered inference (PPI) approach for NAS. PPNAS fuses (1) a small set of architectures with observed performance labels and (2) a large set of architectures with ZCP information. To combine these two sources of supervision, PPNAS exploits the ordinal information provided by ZCPs to construct additional pairwise ranking supervision, while PPI debiases systematic discrepancies between ZCP-based and true performance rankings. We evaluate PPNAS in end-to-end predictor-based NAS, where it achieves state-of-the-art under limited evaluation budgets. To the best of our knowledge, PPNAS is the first prediction-powered approach for label-efficient NAS.

</details>


### [445] [Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01318)
*Hanna Malet,Gabriel Turinici*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究扩散模型在多代训练中，采用固定预算协议（保留所有历史数据但每代仅采样固定大小）与替换协议（用合成数据替换真实数据）对模型崩溃的不同影响，发现固定预算协议能部分保留特征，且线性响应模型揭示了特征的脆弱与鲁棒性差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对模型崩溃得出看似矛盾的结论：替换真实数据导致崩溃，而累积真实数据可防止崩溃。本文旨在探究有限预算流水线中典型的中间 regime：保留所有历史数据但真实数据比例逐渐消失的固定预算协议，以理解其对特征保留的影响。

Method: 在二维螺旋数据集及图像基准（MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10）上进行实验，对比替换协议与固定预算协议下的多代训练表现；并建立多代参数动态的线性响应模型，通过随机递归分析理论验证两种协议的差异。

Result: 实验表明替换协议导致数据集快速退化，而固定预算协议仅部分退化，保留了部分特征。理论分析证实：某些特征在两种协议下均会在几代内丢失（脆弱特征），而另一些特征在固定预算协议下可在实际无限代际中保留（鲁棒特征）。

Conclusion: 固定预算协议通过保留所有历史数据并以固定采样训练，能有效缓解模型崩溃，使部分特征长期保持鲁棒；这为实际有限预算的生成模型训练流水线提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.

</details>


### [446] [Clifford Sheaf Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01322)
*Kotaro Kamiya,Joel Nicholls*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN)，一种用于几何图的等变层神经网络，在细胞层的每个茎上放置Clifford代数，并沿边传输多向量特征。通过放弃代数同态约束，引入K-term sandwich restriction maps，构造了正半定的层拉普拉斯算子，实现了等变性与表达力的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Clifford代数的层神经网络在保持等变性时受限于versor共轭的表达能力不足。需要一种既能保证等变性、又能混合不同grade、且拉普拉斯算子正半定的方法，以解决几何图上的等变回归问题。
